stories.title: UP's last transfer season before 2027 polls:Officers approach RSS, BJP offices; cite family needs for preferred transfers
stories.summary: As the transfer season begins in the Uttar Pradesh government, activity among officers and employees has intensified across departments. Transfer lists for Group A, B, and C officers and employees are expected to be released by May 31, from the government secretariat to various ministries. With the announcement of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections likely in the first weeks of January, this is being seen as the last major transfer window of the Yogi Adityanath government’s second term. As a result, employees are making strong efforts to secure postings at their preferred locations. Several departments are witnessing increased recommendations and lobbying ahead of the final transfer lists. Read the report What are they doing to set up transfers? Circulating around leaders: Government officials who have been hoping for a transfer for a year or two are visiting ministers' offices and homes with their influential relatives, BJP leaders, and MLAs-MPs. Recommendations from the Sangh too: Not just the BJP, but people from the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and BJP's allied organisations are also busy setting up their people through 'Bharti Bhawan' (Sangh headquarters). 20% limit becomes ministers' trouble In an election year, ministers and leaders want to please as many people as possible by fulfilling their recommendations. But the government's transfer policy has tied their hands. To avoid disputes arising from too many transfers, the government has set a maximum limit of 20%. This means that only 20% of the total staff can be transferred. Because of this, ministers and senior officers (Additional Chief Secretaries, Principal Secretaries, and Directors) are under immense pressure. Biggest pressure on large departments Due to being directly connected to the public, the ministers and officers of some specific departments face the heaviest pressure of recommendations. These departments are: Transfer pressure forces ‘zero session’ in key departments In 2025 too, a window of about 15 days was opened for transfers. But the recommendations and pressure increased so much that the government had to implement a 'zero session' (no transfers) in many major departments. These included the Basic Education, Technical Education, Animal Husbandry, and Health departments, where transfer lists could not even be released. More attention to recommendations from RSS and BJP headquarters In this transfer race, the lists coming from the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) and BJP state headquarters are receiving the most importance. The organization sends the final list of names directly to two Officers on Special Duty (OSDs) posted in the Chief Minister's Office. The final responsibility for getting the green light for departments under the CM and other important lists rests with these two OSDs. Ministers also do not take the risk of postponing these lists from the organisation. Ministers of state face more trouble There are 21 Ministers of State in the state government. They do not have much authority for transfers within their own departments. However, being ministers, they face the most pressure from the public and party workers in their constituencies. When they bring recommendations, the departmental Cabinet Ministers do not give them much importance. This often leads to a situation of conflict between the Cabinet Minister and the Minister of State. MLAs also face considerable tension BJP MLAs are also quite troubled during the transfer season. They have to focus on election preparations and also need the support of all party workers. This will only be possible if transfers can also happen based on their recommendations. Experts believe that each MLA is receiving 500 to 1000 recommendations for transfers. This is why most MLAs are currently camped in Lucknow with transfer recommendations. Every day, MLAs are seen visiting ministers' homes with transfer recommendations. Experts believe that the transfer list for most departments will be released between May 28 and 31. After this, department heads and departmental ministers will leave Lucknow for a day or two to avoid facing complaints. Finance Minister said - New policy approved, will complete the process Finance Minister Suresh Khanna had presented the government's official position regarding the new transfer policy after the cabinet meeting held in the first week of May 2026. The Finance Minister stated that the cabinet has approved the new transfer policy, under which the entire transfer process this year will be completed by May 31. He clarified that this time, too, a maximum limit will be set for transfers. Officers who have completed 3 years in one district and 7 years in one division will be compulsorily transferred from there.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Yogi lays foundation stone of international cricket stadium; PM Modi says, 'World is facing decade of crises'
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. PM Modi warns global crises may push world into poverty trap Prime Minister Narendra Modi, addressing the Indian community in The Hague, warned that the world is facing a “decade of crises” due to COVID-19, wars and the energy crisis. He said continued instability could reverse decades of progress and push millions globally into poverty. 2. Yogi lays foundation stone of international cricket stadium in Gorakhpur Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and the Union Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri laid the foundation stone of the International Cricket Stadium in Gorakhpur on Saturday. The event marked a major step toward one of the state’s ambitious sports infrastructure projects. 3. Azam Khan gets 2-year jail in hate speech case Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, who is imprisoned in Rampur Jail, has been handed another sentence. On Saturday afternoon, Rampur's MP-MLA Court sentenced Azam Khan to 2 years in a hate speech case. This hate speech case was related to the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. At that time, Azam was the SP-BSP alliance candidate from Rampur. 4. India may face drought and extreme heat Amid forecasts of below-normal rainfall in India this year, concerns are growing over the return of El Niño. According to the US weather agency, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), El Niño could begin developing between May and July. 5. House linked to Meerut blue drum murder lies abandoned The house linked to the sensational Meerut blue drum murder case now lies abandoned, with locked doors and deserted surroundings reflecting the shock left behind by the crime. Neighbours avoid discussing the case openly, while police continue their investigation into the chilling murder that had sparked massive public attention. 6. Prateek Yadav’s ashes immersed in Ganga at Haridwar: Daughter floats ‘I Love Papa’ card The ashes of SP chief Prateek Yadav were immersed in the Ganga at Haridwar on Saturday in the presence of yoga guru Baba Ramdev. During the emotional ceremony, Prateek’s younger daughter floated a handwritten “I LOVE PAPA” card into the river, leaving family members in tears. 7. Robert Vadra gets bail in ₹58 crore land deal scam Businessman Robert Vadra got bail in the Shikohpur land deal scam in Gurugram on Saturday, 16 May, 2026. The Rouse Avenue Court has granted bail to Robert Vadra on a bail bond of ₹50,000 and one surety. 8. Premanand Maharaj bursts into laughter watching Kailash Kher dance Sufi singer Kailash Kher reached Keli Kunj Ashram in Vrindavan on Friday morning to meet Premanand Maharaj. Kailash Kher greeted Premanand with folded hands, then sang the song Bam Lahari and danced. A video of the same has gone viral on social media platforms. 9. UP sizzles above 45°C, heatwave in 8 districts: Monsoon may enter via Gorakhpur by June 18 Monsoon may arrive in UP around June 18. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said that the monsoon could reach Kerala around May 26. In the last 24 hours, rain was recorded in Kanpur, Hardoi, Badaun, and Jalaun. Meanwhile, Banda remained the hottest city in the state, where the maximum temperature was recorded at 45.2 degrees Celsius. 10. 'Dhurandhar 2' becomes No.1 film in Pakistan Pakistani content creator Mavia Umar Farooqui claims Ranveer Singh's ‘Dhurandhar: The Revenge’ caused a Netflix server crash in Pakistan upon release, allegedly making it the top trending movie.

stories.title: 5 family members dead in Purvanchal Expressway accident:Speeding Dzire rammed parked trailer while travelling from Bihar to Delhi
stories.summary: In Azamgarh, five people were killed on Saturday after a speeding Swift Dzire car rammed into a parked trailer on the Purvanchal Expressway. The car was reportedly travelling at around 135 kmph. All five occupants died on the spot. The vehicle was completely mangled in the crash. Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and sent all the bodies for postmortem examination. Efforts are being made to identify the deceased. The accident took place around 3 PM near milestone number 238 on the Purvanchal Expressway in the Kandharapur police station area. See 4 pictures... Among the dead are 2 girls and one woman The deceased include two men, one woman and two minor girls. Police recovered an identity card from the spot belonging to a person named Manish Srivastava. The ID carried two addresses — Faridabad (Haryana) and Siwan district (Bihar). When police reached the Faridabad address, the house was found locked. Azamgarh Police are now coordinating with Siwan police to establish the identities of the deceased. Officials said there was no survivor who could explain how the accident happened. Car removed using crane The front portion and roof of the white Swift Dzire were completely crushed in the collision. The impact was so severe that the vehicle’s structure was badly compressed. Both front seats and the interior section of the car were almost entirely destroyed. The trailer involved in the accident bore a Rajasthan registration number. A large crane was called to remove the damaged car from the highway. SP Traffic Pankaj Kumar Srivastava said that Dial 112 received information about a Swift Dzire crashing into a stationary trailer near milestone 238 on the Purvanchal Expressway. He said that immediately after the alert, teams from Kandharapur police station, CO City Azamgarh, CCTV unit, fire brigade, ambulance services, and senior officers reached the spot. All the bodies were sent to the mortuary through ambulances, and efforts are underway to contact the families of the deceased.

stories.title: Prateek Yadav’s ashes immersed in Ganga at Haridwar:Daughter floats ‘I Love Papa’ card; wife Aparna breaks down in tears
stories.summary: The ashes of SP chief Prateek Yadav were immersed in the Ganga at Haridwar on Saturday in the presence of yoga guru Baba Ramdev. During the emotional ceremony, Prateek’s younger daughter floated a handwritten “I LOVE PAPA” card into the river, leaving family members in tears. Before the immersion, priests conducted traditional rituals at the ghat. The prayers were led by MP Aditya Yadav, son of Shivpal Singh Yadav. Prateek’s wife Aparna Yadav, their daughters, along with family members including Tej Pratap Yadav and Akshay Yadav, attended the rituals. As the urn was taken for immersion, the younger daughter held it against her forehead and broke down in tears. Earlier, Aparna Yadav also became emotional while carrying the ashes at the ghat, with relatives consoling her. The family had travelled from Lucknow to Dehradun’s Jolly Grant Airport by chartered aircraft before proceeding directly to Haridwar by road. Tej Pratap Yadav was seen carrying the urn, while Akshay Yadav carried the ritual items. Aparna, dressed in a simple saree, appeared visibly grief-stricken throughout the journey. Prateek Yadav died in Lucknow on 13 May at the age of 38. His last rites were performed the following day. He was the son of late Mulayam Singh Yadav and Sadhana Gupta. Aparna Yadav is a BJP leader and currently serves as vice-chairperson of the Uttar Pradesh State Women Commission. See pictures Studied in Britain, stayed away from politics

stories.title: Mother burned alive while saving 4 children in Prayagraj:Daughters rescued by ladder; infant tossed wrapped in sheet
stories.summary: A mother lost her life trying to save her children in Prayagraj. Amidst the fierce fire and smoke, she struggled for about 30 minutes to save her three children. Amidst the rapidly spreading fire, she wrapped her one-year-old infant in a sheet and extended him from the roof towards the neighbors. The neighbors somehow reached out and safely rescued the child. After this, she also safely brought out her two daughters by placing a ladder from her roof to the neighbor's roof across the street. However, during this, she herself got trapped amidst the fire and smoke. Due to the smoke, she started suffocating, and in no time, she was engulfed by the fire and burned alive. This tragic incident occurred on May 12 during a massive fire at the house of a crockery businessman in Prayagraj. On Saturday, a video emerged showing the bravery of the mother who burned alive while saving her children. See pictures

stories.title: Azam Khan gets 2-year jail in hate speech case:SP leader had said, 'I would make officers to clean my shoes'
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, who is imprisoned in Rampur Jail, has been handed another sentence. On Saturday afternoon, Rampur's MP-MLA Court sentenced Azam Khan to 2 years in a hate speech case. This hate speech case was related to the 2019 Lok Sabha elections. At that time, Azam was the SP-BSP alliance candidate from Rampur. During the election campaign, a video of Azam emerged, in which he was saying- "Everyone stand firm, don't be afraid of collectors or officials, they are salaried employees, we are not afraid of them. I have seen many photos of Mayawati. How big officers used to take out handkerchiefs and clean her shoes. We have an alliance with them, and if Allah wills, I will make these officials clean my shoes..." At that time, Anjaneya Kumar Singh was the DM of Rampur, who is now the Commissioner of Moradabad. On his instructions, the then Tanda SDM and flying squad in-charge Ghanshyam Tripathi lodged a complaint against Azam Khan at Bhot police station. Following this, the police registered a hate speech case against him. Azam Khan was out of jail for 55 days last year. In 2022, he was sentenced to 3 years in a hate speech case, but was later acquitted in 2023. However, in the same year, he, his wife Tazeen Fatima and son Abdullah were sentenced to 7 years each in the fake birth certificate case. Following this conviction, he also lost his assembly membership. After spending around 23 months in jail, he was released on bail on 23 September 2025. But just 55 days later, he was again sentenced to 7 years in the fake PAN card case involving his son Abdullah, and both were sent back to jail. Azam and Abdullah kept making one mistake after another

stories.title: 'You should have waited till 13th-day rites':OP Rajbhar calls Akhilesh Yadav power-hungry; says, 'Join my party to become minister in Yogi govt'
stories.summary: Panchayati Raj Minister in Yogi cabinet, Om Prakash Rajbhar has retaliated against Akhilesh Yadav's statement. He wrote on Facebook on Saturday, "Your brother has passed away. I also share your grief, but you are so power-hungry that you are thinking of politics even amidst the family's 'grief'. He said- It seems you have abandoned all shame. At least wait until the thirteenth day ritual. What do you think, that you might also get a department? If interested, join Suhaspa. I will fight with CM Yogi, but I will make you minister of one department. Actually, the cabinet expansion took place in UP on May 10. Six days have passed, but the 6 new faces who took oath and two promoted ministers do not have departments to work in. Political statements have started regarding this. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav had taunted on Friday with an X post. He said, "The real reason for the delay in the distribution of ministries is simply that the 'commission-earnings' distribution is causing a clash between the double engine. Read Rajbhar's full statement Akhilesh ji, your brother has just passed away. The entire family is in distress. That is why I am also sharing your grief. I had stopped speaking and writing about your divisive politics. But you are so power-hungry that even amidst the family's 'grief', you are thinking about politics and what is happening in other people's homes. You are more concerned about this. It seems you have abandoned public decency. Just wait until the thirteenth-day ritual, then we can engage in the politics of ideas. You can say something to us, and we will tell you something... But if your departed brother is watching this behavior, what would he be thinking? Have a little consideration. As for the distribution of departments after the cabinet expansion, what do you think, will you also get a department? If you are interested, join Suhaspa, I will fight with Honorable Chief Minister Yogiji, but I will make you a minister of one department. Akhilesh, the madman, in an alien cabinet!) What Akhilesh Yadav had said, read verbatim: 21 hours ago, Akhilesh Yadav had said on Yogi's cabinet expansion: "After the names of ministers in UP, will the 'slips' for their departments also come from above now? The real reason for the delay in the distribution of ministries is simply that the 'double engine' is clashing over the distribution of 'commission-earnings'." The new ministers, appointed after a long wait, are merely sitting in the spectators' gallery, watching the ball move back and forth. The BJP's 'double engine' renders all other ministers ineffective. The people of UP have resolved that whatever ministry or department the new ministers receive, it will be thoroughly watched and monitored, so that these newly appointed ministers cannot fill their own coffers. For this, along with documentary evidence, audio-video proofs will also be collected, and the true colors of these BJP members will be exposed. Now the public itself will stop the BJP members from looting their tax money, because the corrupt BJP has already ruined all other departments meant to stop corruption. The public feels that now they can only get justice through social media and citizen journalism. The BJP government knows that this is the last time it is in power, which is why these BJP members want to amass money greedily. The aware public will now not let these BJP members succeed in their dirty schemes. Social media war between Akhilesh-Rajbhar For some time now, a social media battle has been going on between the SP chief and Yogi's minister OP Rajbhar. OP Rajbhar is openly commenting on every statement and post of Akhilesh. Regarding photos with Mamata-Stalin, he said - they will set a new record of defeat On May 7, Akhilesh Yadav met former West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee and former Tamil Nadu CM MK Stalin at their private residences. Sharing pictures of the meeting on social media, he said - Mamata Didi, you fought you haven't lost.. Reacting to Akhilesh's post, OP Rajbhar said- He went to console him, saying you have only lost once, we have lost twice. Let's create a new series of losses together. When the Bengal election results were coming in, Akhilesh didn't say anything for 4 hours, now he went to talk. It seems Akhilesh will set a new record for defeat this time. Spent cartridges have gathered in SP OP Rajbhar, who arrived in Jaunpur two days ago, took a dig at Akhilesh while speaking to the media. When asked about going with Akhilesh Yadav in the 2027 assembly elections, he said, “No one wants to sit on a sinking ship. In SP, vacant cartridges have gathered. There is no leader left in the party who has the ability to win an assembly seat on their own.”

The event marked a major step toward one of the state’s ambitious sports infrastructure projects. Before the ceremony, the Union Minister offered prayers at Guru Gorakhnath temple. During the event, MP Ravi Kishan arrived in a carpool with Union Minister Kamlesh Paswan and Kushinagar MP Vijay Dubey, reflecting a notable political presence at the site. See pictures ₹393 crore dream sports project The International Cricket Stadium is being developed at an estimated cost of ₹393 crore and is considered one of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s key dream projects. Following the Chief Minister’s announcement, construction work began on December 24, 2025, on land provided by the administration in Tal Nador. Construction progress and timeline An initial installment of ₹63.39 crore has already been released for the project, and construction work is currently underway. According to the Public Works Department’s Construction Division One (Building), around 7% of the work has been completed so far. The stadium is scheduled to be completed by December 23, 2027, as per the executing agency’s timeline.

stories.title: Premanand Maharaj bursts into laughter watching Kailash Kher dance:Sings Bam Lahiri wearing peacock-feather garland; gazes at Banke Bihari
stories.summary: Sufi singer Kailash Kher reached Keli Kunj Ashram in Vrindavan on Friday morning to meet Premanand Maharaj. Kailash Kher garlanded Premanand with a peacock feather garland. He greeted him with folded hands, then sang the song Bam Lahari and danced. Hearing Kailash Kher's devotional song and watching his dance, Premanand Maharaj laughed heartily. Earlier on Thursday evening, Kailash Kher had darshan of Lord Banke Bihari. During this time, he kept gazing intently at the Lord's image. He stayed in the temple for about 30 minutes. First see 3 pictures... Famous bhajan singer Kailash Kher reached Vrindavan late Thursday evening. He stayed at a five-star hotel. After this, Kailash Kher reached Banke Bihari Temple. Kailash Kher kept gazing at the image of Lord Banke Bihari seated in Phool Bangla. Here he applied perfume on the threshold. During this, sevayat Mohit Goswami presented him with the Lord's prasadi, angavastra and prasad. Premanand Maharaj inquired about the singer's well-being On Friday morning, Kailash Kher reached Keli Kunj Ashram. The ashram's volunteers welcomed him by draping a dupatta. Premanand Maharaj asked Kailash Kher, are you well? To which the singer said - I'm great. After this, Kailash Kher took the mic and folded his hands. Then he started singing the Bam Lahari song. After listening to the song, Premanand Maharaj said - Very beautiful When Kailash Kher suddenly started dancing while singing the bhajan, Sant Premanand Maharaj started smiling. After listening to the 1 minute 30 second bhajan, Sant Premanand Maharaj praised the singer. After this, Kailash Kher said - I want to sing one more bhajan. To which Sant Premanand said - Yes. Kailash Kher sang the bhajan "5 varsh ki Meera Ladli ho, sakhiyan mein khela jaye ri, sun rana bai ri" in his own style to Sant Premanand Maharaj. After listening to this bhajan, Sant Premanand Maharaj said - "Very good voice." After this, Kailash Kher took blessings from Sant Premanand Maharaj and left from there.

stories.title: UP sizzles above 45°C, heatwave in 8 districts:Monsoon may enter via Gorakhpur by June 18; nights to stay warmer
stories.summary: Monsoon may arrive in UP around June 18. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said that the monsoon could reach Kerala around May 26. He said - "Considering the current situation, it has been estimated that the monsoon will enter Uttar Pradesh via Gorakhpur on June 18. However, this is a probable date. The exact date can only be assessed when the monsoon moves beyond Kerala." On Saturday, the weather is clear in Western and Eastern Uttar Pradesh. There is bright sunshine. The Meteorological Department has issued a heatwave alert for 8 districts including Jhansi and Lalitpur. In the last 24 hours, rain was recorded in Kanpur, Hardoi, Badaun, and Jalaun. Meanwhile, Banda remained the hottest city in the state, where the maximum temperature was recorded at 45.2 degrees Celsius. Due to storms and rain on Wednesday and Thursday, 111 people died in the state. On Friday, players of Lucknow Super Giants and Chennai Super Kings observed a two-minute silence at Lucknow's Ekana Stadium to mourn the deaths. Meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said - The effect of the Western Disturbance has ended. Now the temperature will increase. It will be hot during the day as well as at night. There is a possibility of a heatwave and increasing heat. The mercury can reach up to 47 degrees. See weather pictures- Less rain will occur in UP during monsoon, know the reason Between June and September, Uttar Pradesh is also likely to receive less than normal rainfall. Dr. M. Mohapatra, Director General of the India Meteorological Department, stated that this year, conditions similar to La Nia in the Pacific Ocean are ending and showing signs of moving towards El Nio, which will cause less rainfall. This means that this year, there are indications of the Southwest Monsoon being weaker than normal. Additionally, the reduced snow cover in the Northern Hemisphere during January-March this year can also affect the monsoon. Last year, monsoon rained 10 to 15% more According to the Meteorological Department, Uttar Pradesh recorded an average rainfall of 870 to 900 mm during the 2025 monsoon season (June to September). This was about 10 to 15 percent more than the normal monsoon average. Crops damaged by storms and rain, Yogi says - Government stands with the people Crops have also suffered heavy damage due to the rain and storms on Wednesday and Thursday. Vegetable crops, especially cucumber, gherkin, and watermelon, have been most affected. CM Yogi had said on Thursday that in this hour of disaster, the government stands with the farmers and the public. Continuous monitoring is being done at the government level so that assistance can reach those in need on time. Any kind of negligence by officers in relief work will not be tolerated. How will the weather be for the next 3 days? Why is the weather fluctuating? The Meteorological Department says that the weather in the mountains of Uttarakhand is constantly changing. There is snowfall in some places and rain in others. On some days, the weather clears up with sunshine. Similar fluctuations are expected for the next few days. Its effect is visible in UP. Winds coming from the mountains have kept the weather cold. They are creating systems favorable for rain.

stories.title: House linked to Meerut blue drum murder lies abandoned:Residents fear passing through lane, owner says no buyer for 14 months
stories.summary: Our life completely changed after Saurabh’s murder. People now call our home the ‘murder house’. Our only mistake was that we rented the house to Saurabh and Muskan, thinking they were a decent family. These are the words of Ompal, a resident of Meerut whose rented house became the centre of a shocking murder case in March 2025. On March 3, 2025, Muskan, along with her boyfriend Sahil, allegedly murdered her husband Saurabh. The body was cut into pieces, placed inside a blue plastic drum and covered with cement mixture to hide the crime. Ompal said the house has remained locked for the past 14 months since the murder case came to light. The police sealed the property and kept the keys. He said the closure has caused major financial losses because the family depended on rent for household expenses. The Dainik Bhaskar team visited Ompal’s house in Indira Nagar area of Meerut and spoke to him about the incident and its impact on his life. Part-1: ‘We trusted them because they looked like a good family’ Elderly couple lived beside tenants Ompal owns a two-storey house built on a 200-square-yard plot in the Brahmpuri police station area. He lives there with his wife, while other portions were rented out to tenants. Around three years ago, he rented one portion of the house to Saurabh and Muskan for Rs 6,000 per month. Their daughter Pihu also lived with them. According to Ompal, Saurabh appeared polite and responsible, which is why the family agreed to rent out the house. He later learned that Muskan’s maternal home was nearby, which increased their trust in the couple. Rent and bills were always paid on time Ompal said Saurabh later moved to London for work while Muskan continued living in the house with their daughter. Every month, Saurabh sent money online and Muskan paid the rent in cash. Electricity bills were also cleared regularly. He said the couple never created any problems for the landlords and their daughter’s presence made the elderly couple feel comfortable. ‘Our only son also died’ Ompal said he originally belonged to Haryana and earlier ran a cloth business in Meerut. After his only son died within two years of marriage, he shut down the business and began depending on rent for survival. He said the rent from tenants helped him and his wife manage daily expenses. ‘Sahil used to visit the house’ When asked about Sahil, Ompal said he had seen him visiting Muskan several times. Initially, Sahil came to deliver online parcels, but later started entering the house as well. Ompal also claimed that Muskan mostly stayed indoors and frequently ordered food online instead of cooking at home. ‘I unknowingly took her to buy medicines’ Ompal said Muskan once asked him to take her to a medical store on his scooter because she was unwell and unable to go alone. He said he waited outside while Muskan purchased medicines using a prescription. He claimed he neither checked the prescription nor knew what medicines she bought. Couple had gone to village during murder Ompal said Saurabh had returned from London to Meerut around March 1, 2025, after nearly two years abroad. Around the same time, he and his wife went to their village for personal work. When they returned on March 15, they found the rented portion locked. Muskan later told them that she, Saurabh and their daughter had gone out sightseeing. Ompal said they had no idea that Saurabh’s body was allegedly hidden inside a drum kept in the house. Part-2: ‘We realised later the murder happened inside our house’ ‘We were shocked when police arrived’ Ompal recalled that Muskan returned alone on March 17. When asked about Saurabh, she reportedly said he would arrive later. Later that afternoon, police vehicles and crowds gathered outside the house. Ompal said he initially believed some incident had happened nearby, but soon realised the crime had taken place inside his own property. He said the family was shocked and struggled to believe that such a crime had happened in their house. Part-3: ‘We are suffering for someone else’s crime’ ‘People treat us like criminals’ Speaking emotionally, Ompal said he and his wife are facing social humiliation despite having no role in the crime. “If we had even the slightest idea about such intentions, we would never have kept them as tenants,” he said. He added that people now look at them with suspicion and behave as if they were responsible for the murder. Health worsened after the case Ompal said the stress from the case badly affected his health. He claimed to have lost nearly 25 kg in one year and developed problems related to blood pressure, diabetes and the heart. He also said his eyesight deteriorated and even surgery did not help because of continuous stress. Relatives and neighbours stopped visiting According to Ompal, relatives, neighbours and friends gradually distanced themselves after the murder case. He said people in the locality stare at them and avoid conversations. Even relatives hesitate to visit the house because of fear linked to the incident. Unable to sell the property Ompal said the house has remained sealed for more than a year and he has not been allowed to enter it. The family has received no rent during this period, though electricity bills continue to arrive. He said several property dealers were approached to sell the house, but no buyer showed interest because of the murder case. Wants to return to village Ompal said he now wants the legal process to finish so the house can be released. He plans to sell the property and return to his village in Haryana with his wife. “We only want peace for the remaining years of our life,” he said quietly.

stories.title: UP cabinet tussle:Bhupendra and Keshav eye PWD; AK Sharma seeks powerful ministry in exchange for Energy
stories.summary: Six days after the Uttar Pradesh cabinet expansion on May 10, the six newly inducted ministers and two promoted ministers are still waiting for their departments. The delay has now triggered political sparring between the BJP and the Samajwadi Party. Akhilesh Yadav targets BJP over delay Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav took a jibe at the BJP government on Friday through a post on X. He claimed the delay was due to a clash between the “double-engine governments” over the sharing of “commission earnings”. The newly appointed ministers had taken oath in the presence of Governor Anandiben Patel and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Tug-of-war over key ministries According to government sources, the main deadlock is over the allocation of important portfolios to newly inducted cabinet ministers Bhupendra Chaudhary and Manoj Pandey. Supporters of both leaders are pushing for major departments in line with their political stature. The reshuffle is expected to affect at least five ministers, including the Chief Minister. However, ministers from alliance parties are unlikely to lose their departments, limiting the government’s options. Currently, Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya and Urban Development Minister AK Sharma hold multiple departments, making them central to the reshuffle discussions. PWD and Energy departments at centre of discussions Sources said there is pressure from the BJP’s central leadership to give Keshav Prasad Maurya an important ministry. His supporters are demanding the Public Works Department (PWD), which he handled during the government’s first term. At present, the PWD department is with the Chief Minister after previously being handled by Jitin Prasada. Supporters of Bhupendra Chaudhary are also lobbying for the same department, citing his seniority and former role as BJP state president. The Energy Department has also become a key issue. The portfolio is currently with AK Sharma, who is considered close to the party’s central leadership. Sources said the Chief Minister wants to hand the department to Manoj Pandey, but that would require giving AK Sharma another influential ministry. Rural Development is being considered as another possible option for Manoj Pandey, but that may depend on whether Keshav Prasad Maurya gets the PWD department. Independent charge ministers also awaiting departments Ajit Singh Pal and Somendra Tomar, who were promoted to Ministers of State (Independent Charge), are also waiting for departments. Sources said one of them may get the Mining Department while the other could be assigned the Food Processing Ministry. Offices allotted, portfolios still pending Even though departments have not been assigned, office rooms have already been allotted to the newly inducted ministers. Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary has been given a room in Vidhan Bhavan, while Manoj Pandey and other ministers have received office space in Bapu Bhavan. Yogi meets Amit Shah and BJP chief in Delhi After the cabinet expansion, CM Yogi Adityanath held a meeting with ministers at his residence and later travelled to Delhi on Thursday. There, he met Union Home Minister Amit Shah and BJP national president Nitin Naveen. Sources said the meetings focused on the distribution of portfolios. There were expectations that the departments would be allocated on Friday, but the Chief Minister instead travelled to Maharajganj and Gorakhpur for official programmes. BJP says there is no issue Responding to the opposition’s criticism, BJP spokesperson Rakesh Tripathi said there was no deadlock over the allocation of ministries. He said the Chief Minister was out of the capital and portfolio distribution is entirely his prerogative.

stories.title: Massive fire erupts in Ghaziabad society:Neighbours rescue 12 trapped residents, including children, before flames engulf two flats
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out on Monday evening in a residential society located in Shalimar Garden, Ghaziabad. The blaze started in a third-floor flat and quickly engulfed the entire apartment before spreading to a fourth-floor flat as well. Smoke traps 12 residents, children among those rescued Thick smoke filled both flats after the fire, trapping 12 people inside and leaving them struggling to breathe. The trapped residents included a four-year-old boy and a young girl. Neighbours rushed to help and safely evacuated everyone before firefighters arrived. The flames were so intense that they shot nearly 20 feet high, while smoke could be seen from almost a kilometre away. Fire brought under control after one hour Five fire tenders reached the spot soon after receiving information and launched a rescue and firefighting operation. Officials managed to bring the blaze under control after nearly an hour of efforts. The fire broke out in Flat No. 815 on the top floor of a society in Shalimar Garden Extension-1. Chief Fire Officer Rahul Pal said 12 people were rescued safely from the building. Two flats were damaged in the incident.

stories.title: Main accused arrested in Suvendu Adhikari's PA's murder:Ballia resident caught returning from Haridwar with family
stories.summary: Another youth from UP has been arrested in the murder case of Chandranath Rath, personal assistant to Bengal leader Shubhendu Adhikari. The CBI arrested Rajkumar Singh, a Ballia resident, from Muzaffarnagar. Earlier, on May 10, another accused, Raj Singh, also from Ballia, was arrested from Ayodhya. 42-two-year-old Chandranath Rath was shot dead on May 6, two days after the Bengal election results. The attackers intercepted his car and opened fire, hitting him three times in the chest and stomach. Given the seriousness of the case, the investigation was later handed over to the CBI. Rajkumar was nabbed near the toll plaza while returning from Haridwar The CBI was already aware of Rajkumar's activities. Information was received that he was returning from Haridwar. Based on this, the CBI team laid a trap near the toll plaza located in the Chhappar area of Muzaffarnagar. As soon as Rajkumar's vehicle reached near the toll early Monday morning, the CBI team caught him. After this, he was interrogated for a long time. Got 24-hour remand from court CBI's CO Rajesh Kumar presented Rajkumar in the CJM court, from where he was granted 24-hour remand. Now CBI is engaged in interrogating him to find out about the murder conspiracy and other people involved in it. Along with this, he will be questioned about his links with Raj Singh, also a resident of Ballia. Know who is Rajkumar, whom CBI has caught Tribhuvan Singh, a resident of Ballia, used to work in LT in Ayodhya. After retiring in March, he has been at home. He has 2 sons and one daughter. The daughter is the eldest. The youngest son studies in class-5. Rajkumar Singh is Tribhuvan's elder son. He has studied up to BA first year. He dropped out of studies as he lost interest. After this, he started working as a crane helper in Mumbai. However, he left the job and came home 8 months ago. Rajkumar was preparing to go abroad for work-related purposes after getting a passport made. About 3 years ago, he had been to jail after his name came up in a dispute with people of the Harijan community in Rattopur village of Ballia. The first accused Raj Singh was caught on May 10 In the murder of PA Chandranath Rath, Raj Singh, a resident of Ballia, was caught from Ayodhya on May 10. After this, he was sent to 13 days of police custody by the court. After the arrest, a poster of Raj Singh had surfaced. In this, he has described himself as the State General Secretary of Akhil Bharatiya Kshatriya Mahasabha. His Facebook account has a picture with Minister Dayashankar Singh. There is also a reel of him with former MP Brij Bhushan Singh. According to neighbors, Raj wanted to become a leader. He was preparing to contest the Block Chief election. Suspicion of 8 people being involved in the murder Investigation agencies believe that at least 8 people were involved in the murder conspiracy and the crime. These people had conducted reconnaissance for several days before killing PA Chandranath Rath. The attackers' car had passed through Bali Toll Plaza before the murder. Here, a person present in the car had made the toll payment through UPI. Through the mobile number linked to this digital transaction, the police identified one accused. Then they reached the remaining accused. Meanwhile, the Bengal Police, after initial investigation, had expressed suspicion of contract killers being involved in the murder of Chandranath Rath. The police had said that Rath's murder was carried out in a planned manner. Professional shooters could be involved in this. The police had seized a car from the crime scene, which was used to chase Rath's Scorpio. The car's number plate turned out to be fake. The car's chassis and engine number had been erased. Apart from this, 2 bikes were involved in the attack. One of these bikes was also found about 4 km away from the crime scene near a tea shop. It also had fake registration. Understand the entire incident through a 90-minute timeline Chandranath left Kolkata around 9 o'clock : Chandranath was returning from Kolkata to his rented house in Madhyamgram in a Scorpio. The driver was driving the vehicle. Chandranath was sitting beside him. Scorpio seen in CCTV at 10 PM: At 9:58 PM in Madhyamgram, about 20 kilometers from Kolkata, Chandranath's Scorpio was seen passing through the street in a CCTV camera. Shortly after the Scorpio passed, three people on a car and two bikes were seen following from the area. 10:30 AM car blocked the Scorpio's path: Near Doharia Junction in Madhyamgram, the car overtook the Scorpio and stopped ahead, blocking its way. The Scorpio driver had to stop the vehicle. Bike-borne attacker started firing: Before Chandranath and his driver could understand anything, the bike-borne attackers came from the left side and fired 6 to 10 rounds. Criminals fled abandoning the car: After executing the incident, the criminals abandoned the car there and fled on motorcycles via two different routes. Car's number plate fake: Police seized the car from the spot, but when the number was checked, it turned out to be fake. The car's chassis number had also been tampered with. Glock 47X pistol used in murder: The attackers used a Glock 47X pistol. Common criminals do not use such modern weapons. The way the attack was carried out, only a professional shooter could have executed it.

stories.title: MLA Raja Bhaiya claims Muslims were once Hindus:Calls religious conversion an act of cowardice; maulana responds
stories.summary: 'All the Muslims today were Hindus before. They did not come from Arabia. Those who were faithless, cowardly and under pressure converted their religion. Whereas the brave and sacrificing people remained steadfast in their religion.' These statements were made by strongman MLA Raghuraj Pratap Singh 'Raja Bhaiya'. He had attended a religious discourse on May 16 near Prayagraj district. His video surfaced on Monday. Raja Bhaiya said, if Sanatan becomes weak, then the Constitution will also not remain. Many people must have been seen saying, Jai Samvidhan (Hail Constitution). But let us tell you, the day India ceases to be Hindu-majority, they will tear up the Constitution and throw it away, we also know and you also know. National President of All India Muslim Jamaat, Maulana Shahabuddin Razvi Barelvi has retaliated against Raja Bhaiya's statement. He said, people accepted Islam of their own will and happiness. The Muslims who are in crores in India today are residents of this place only and all are Indians. If a DMK leader had spoken against Islam, how big would the protest have been? On Tamil Nadu's former Deputy CM Udhayanidhi Stalin statement on Sanatan Dharma, Raja Bhaiya said, there is a leader in Tamil Nadu who says that Sanatan Dharma should be eliminated. It is dengue, it is malaria, comparisons were made with various diseases. Hindus are the most despicable caste. Now imagine, if someone had talked about eliminating Islam, how big a protest would have taken place. We have to fight this battle ourselves. That's why I say, "Leaving aside caste distinctions, we are all Hindu brothers." Raja Bhaiya said, India is the most populous country and also the largest democracy. The credit goes to the fact that there is a Hindu majority society here. India is a secular nation because it is Hindu-dominated, Sanatan-dominated. Hindu religion has an important role in this diversity of India. If India is a secular nation today, the reason is that it is a Hindu-majority country. If it were not so, we would not be in the form we are today at all. Emphasizing unity in society, Raja Bhaiya said, leaving aside caste distinctions, we are all Hindu brothers. He appealed to people to bid farewell to caste discrimination and spread the message that we are all Hindu brothers. He said that caste divisions within society are the biggest reason for weakness, which opposing forces take advantage of. Udhayanidhi Stalin had said - Sanatan Dharma should be eliminated Udhayanidhi Stalin had said in the Assembly on May 12 that Sanatan Dharma should be eliminated. It divides people. On May 14, Udhayanidhi Stalin clarified his statement. He said - My statement is being misunderstood. I am not against people going to temples, just that the discrimination that happens there on the basis of caste, that mindset needs to be eliminated. Udhayanidhi Stalin had made a statement against Sanatan Dharma at an event on September 2, 2023. Udhayanidhi said - Sanatan Dharma is like mosquito, dengue, fever, malaria and corona, which cannot merely be opposed, but need to be eliminated. When the controversy escalated, Udhayanidhi said that I am not against Hinduism but against Sanatan practices. Voices have been raised against Sanatan Dharma in Tamil Nadu for the past 100 years. We will continue to speak against it for the next 200 years as well. In the past, on many occasions, Ambedkar and Periyar have also spoken about this. It is only because of strong opposition to Sanatan Dharma that women could step out of their homes and social evils like Sati were abolished. He said - In fact, DMK was founded on principles that oppose such social evils. Udhayanidhi was also reprimanded by the Supreme Court The Supreme Court reprimanded Udayanidhi Stalin on March 4, 2025. The Supreme Court said that Stalin has misused his rights. Stalin is not a common man. He should have thought about the consequences of his statement. Maulana said- Raja Bhaiya has not given any new statement National President of All India Muslim Jamaat, Maulana Shahabuddin Razvi Barelvi said, the statement given by Raja Bhaiya is not a new statement. Many people in India say such things. We also believe that some Muslims came to India from Arabia. They explained the virtues of Islam here and propagated it. The Sufi saints conveyed the teachings of Islam to the people. Influenced by it, people accepted Islam. No one was given any inducement, nor was any pressure applied on anyone. Muslim rulers also did not force anyone. If the complete biography of the Prophet of Islam is read, he too never pressured anyone. People accepted Islam of their own will and happiness. Today, the millions of Muslims in India are residents of this very place and all are Indians.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Yogi cabinet clears backward commission for Panchayat polls; VD Satheesan takes oath as Kerala CM more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. VD Satheesan takes oath as Kerala CM VD Satheesan was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Kerala. Rajendra Arlekar also administered the oath of office to 20 other ministers in the new cabinet. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi attended the ceremony. Former Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, BJP leader Rajeev Chandrasekhar and chief ministers from Congress-ruled states were also present. 2. Yogi cabinet clears backward commission for Panchayat polls For the first time after the cabinet expansion, a meeting was held on Monday under the chairmanship of CM Yogi in Lucknow. In this, 12 proposals were approved, including the expansion of Lucknow Metro. The formation of an OBC commission for conducting Panchayat elections has been approved. 3. Banda becomes country’s hottest district: 57,000 tonnes of sand extracted daily from Ken River Banda has once again recorded extreme heat. On May 16, the district became the hottest place in Uttar Pradesh with the temperature touching 44.8°C. Earlier, on April 27, Banda was also recorded as the hottest district in the country when the mercury reached 47.6°C. Experts say this is not happening suddenly, but is linked to the fast destruction of natural resources in the area. 4. Iran officially announces new body to manage Hormuz Iran's top security body announced on Monday the formation of a new body to manage the Strait of Hormuz, which Tehran has effectively closed and wants to charge ships to traverse. 5. Uproar, stone pelting and baton charge in Lucknow: 240 lawyers’ chambers demolished with bulldozers A huge commotion erupted outside the Lucknow District Court on Sunday. Lawyers got agitated in protest against the demolition of chambers by bulldozers. A lathi-charge was carried out to disperse the crowd of lawyers. The police chased them and rained down blows with sticks. 6. ‘Kyu Mangey Udhaar Jab Apna Neta Taiyaar ’: Chirag's posters spark buzz in UP Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Chirag Paswan’s Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) has started showing its strength in Lucknow through new posters and political messages. The posters carry the slogan, “Why should leaders ask for loans, when our own leader is ready?” 7. CBI raids Latur coaching centre in NEET leak case In the NEET paper leak case, a team from the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has been in Latur, Maharashtra, for the past five days. On Sunday, the team raided the main office of Renukai Chemistry Classes (RCC) coaching centre in the Shivnagar area. The investigation continued there from the afternoon until evening. 8. US fitness influencer amazed by Brij Bhushan’s lavish estate American fitness icon and social media influencer Ashton Hall reached Gonda for a two-day visit. During the visit, he met former BJP MP Brijbhushan Singh and his MP son Karan Bhushan Singh. Ashton Hall was surprised after seeing Brijbhushan Singh’s 15-acre mansion and his helicopter. 9. Deadly road crash in Uttar Pradesh claims 10 lives: Teacher and engineer among victims Ten people were killed after a Magic vehicle collided with a truck at around 7.30 am on Monday in Lakhimpur Kheri. All the victims were travelling in the Magic vehicle. Nine people died on the spot, while one later died in hospital. The dead included a government school teacher and an engineer. 10. MS Dhoni flaunts his shooting skills, hits all 6 targets Former Indian captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni arrived at the Regional Hub of the National Security Guards (NSG) in Chennai on Sunday, amidst the IPL. Here, he fired a submachine gun (small machine gun). He also aimed with a pistol, and the 44-year-old Dhoni spent time with the commandos and their families.

stories.title: 25-year-old woman dies after fall from 3rd floor:Father alleges murder and body was thrown
stories.summary: A 25-year-old woman died after falling from the third floor of a house in Greater Noida. She had been married for about one and a half years. The woman's maternal family alleges that their daughter was murdered. The father says that after the marriage, the in-laws were demanding a Fortuner car and 51 lakh rupees. When this demand was not fulfilled, they killed my daughter. There were injury marks on her body. The case is from the Ecotech-3 police station area dated May 17. Now read the complete case Father Sanjay Nagar said - We live in Kudi Kheda village. I work at Delhi Jal Board. I got my daughter Deepika Nagar married to Ritik, a resident of Jalpura, on December 11, 2024. Deepika had completed her B.Ed, while her husband Ritik is studying in the second year of law. I had spent around 1 crore rupees on the wedding. I gave a top model Scorpio car. Since the wedding, the in-laws were harassing my daughter. On May 17 too, the in-laws had beaten the daughter Sanjay Nagar said - On May 17, my daughter Deepika called me. She said that her in-laws were beating her. They were asking for a car and money as dowry. I reached my daughter's in-laws' house in the evening and talked to them and explained. After that I came home. Then late at night at 12:30, the in-laws called saying that Deepika had fallen from the roof. You people should come to Sharda Hospital. When I reached the hospital, I saw that my daughter had died. There were injury marks on her body. The father alleged that the in-laws murdered Deepika and threw her body down from the third floor. The father has filed a complaint against father-in-law Manoj, mother-in-law Poonam, husband Ritik, sisters-in-law Neha and Tanvi, and paternal uncles-in-law Pramod and Vinod. Father-in-law has three private schools Police investigation revealed that father-in-law Manoj has three private schools. Two of these schools go up to 10th grade, while one goes up to 8th grade. He also deals in property business. DCP of Central Noida Shailendra Singh said- Information was received about the death of a married woman who fell from the third floor. The deceased's family members have accused the in-laws of murder and harassment for dowry. After registering a case in this matter, father-in-law Manoj and husband Ritik have been arrested.This is a picture of the accused husband Ritik, who is in police custody. Injury marks found on body According to sources, Deepika's postmortem report revealed liver injury along with blood clots in the head. Injury marks on the body have also been reported. However, fracture has not been confirmed. The viscera has been preserved and sent for examination. Meanwhile, on Monday itself, accused Ritik and his father Manoj were presented in Surajpur court. From there, both were sent to jail on 14 days judicial custody. Now see 2 pictures of Deepika's wedding Deepika had completed B.Ed, while her husband Hrithik is studying law. The husband has been arrested by the police.

stories.title: No shortage of oil or gas, adequate stock available:UP records daily sale of 33 lakh litres diesel 20 lakh litres petrol
stories.summary: There is no shortage of petrol, diesel, or gas in Uttar Pradesh, and the supply system is operating completely normally with adequate stock available. This was stated by Sanjay Bhandari, Executive Director of the State Level Coordinator (Oil Industry), Uttar Pradesh. Bhandari said that the supply of petrol, diesel, and domestic LPG across the state is fully stable and uninterrupted. He added that there is no situation of shortage or disruption, and continuous supply is being ensured from terminals and depots to retail outlets. Daily fuel consumption and supply network in UP He informed that Uttar Pradesh consumes around 20 lakh litres of petrol and 33 lakh litres of diesel every day. The state has a total of 13,168 petrol pumps operated by Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited, Indian Oil Corporation, and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited. Bhandari also said that the system has maintained a stock of 15 to 20 days since the onset of the war situation. On the LPG front, Uttar Pradesh has around 4.88 crore domestic gas connections, supported by 4,143 active distribution agencies, with a stock buffer of 5 to 6 days. Authorities dismiss rumours of shortage He appealed to people not to believe rumours or engage in unnecessary panic buying or hoarding of petrol, diesel, or LPG. Bhandari said that false information circulating on social media had led to crowding at some places, but clarified that the entire supply chain remains strong and fully functional, with no shortage at any level.

stories.title: Major fire engulfs 4-storey hotel in Prayagraj:12 trapped rescued after transformer blast triggers blaze
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out on Monday afternoon at the four-storey Vittal Hotel in the Civil Lines area of Prayagraj, triggering panic in the busy locality. At the time of the incident, 12 people were trapped inside the building, but all were safely rescued by alert fire personnel after a swift evacuation operation. Transformer blast suspected as trigger Preliminary police investigation indicates that the fire was likely triggered after a blast in a transformer located adjacent to the hotel. The explosion reportedly produced sparks that ignited the wooden elements of the structure. Strong winds in the area further worsened the situation, allowing the flames to spread rapidly and engulf the entire hotel within minutes. Massive rescue operation, no casualties reported Fire services deployed eight fire tenders along with a hydraulic ladder to tackle the blaze. Around 36 fire personnel were involved in continuous firefighting and cooling operations. The flames were brought under control after nearly two hours of intense effort, around 3:30 pm. Although the fire caused extensive damage, no loss of life was reported. However, two motorcycles parked on the premises were destroyed, and a significant portion of the hotel structure was reduced to ashes. Senior officials, including fire department teams and police personnel from three stations, remained present at the spot throughout the operation to manage the situation and ensure safety in the surrounding area. stories.title: Yogi Adityanath warns against namaz on roads before Bakrid:Says, 'If people don’t listen politely, other methods will be used’
stories.summary: A week before Bakrid, UP CM Yogi Adityanath warned against offering namaz on roads. Speaking at an event in Lucknow on Monday, he said, “Namaz will not be allowed on roads. If people agree peacefully, fine; otherwise, stricter measures will be taken." If you want to offer namaz, do it at a designated place. If the numbers are more, do it in shifts. We will not stop namaz, but we will not allow anarchy on roads. Roads are not for offering namaz or gathering crowds of any kind. He said, “People ask me whether namaz happens on roads in UP? I say, ”absolutely not. Roads are for common people to walk on. No one has the right to come and disturb traffic." CM Yogi said, “People tried their hand in Bareilly, and they also saw the strength of the government. The law is equal for everyone. No one will be allowed to block roads or create disorder.” He was referring to the violence in Bareilly in September 2025 over the ‘I Love Mohammad’ controversy. Muslim leader Maulana Tauqeer Raza had announced a sit-in protest after namaz. When police tried to stop the gathering, stone-pelting broke out, following which police resorted to lathi-charge. Highlighting UP’s development, Yogi said the state was once known for guns and bombs, but is now manufacturing BrahMos missiles. “If the atmosphere is negative, ‘One District-One Mafia’ emerges. If it is positive, ‘One District-One Product’ is created,” he said, adding that investment and employment are rapidly increasing in the state. He claimed UP is on track to become a 1 trillion-dollar economy. On women’s safety, the CM said women in UP earlier feared stepping out even during the day, but are now working night shifts and returning home safely. “No one can harass daughters now,” he said. Yogi added that UP is no longer a ‘BIMARU state’ and has remained revenue surplus for the past six years. He further said the state no longer needs to depend on anyone and has immense potential in agriculture, infrastructure and youth power. According to him, the government is focusing on balanced development across all 75 districts. Yogi had also raised the issue of namaz on roads during the recent West Bengal Assembly election campaign. Targeting former Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee over alleged appeasement politics, he had said, “Didi allows namaz on roads and restricts Hindu festivals. In UP, roads are meant for traffic, not namaz. There is no curfew, no riots, and everything is peaceful.” Yogi government had banned offering namaz on roads The Yogi government completely banned namaz on roads in 2022-2023. Orders were issued that namaz would not be offered on roads on Eid, Alvida Jumma or any other day. Religious events should only be held inside Eidgah, mosques or designated religious places.

stories.title: Man crushed to death while filming reel:Tractor tyre ran over him after stunt went wrong during pond-side bath
stories.summary: A young man died in Pilibhit while attempting a deadly stunt with a tractor in a river. During the stunt, the young man came under the tractor's wheel in the middle of the river and drowned in deep water. Nearby people jumped into the river to try and save him, but he could not be found. Upon receiving information, the police arrived and, with the help of divers and a JCB, pulled out the young man and the tractor. However, by then the young man had already died. After the incident, the deceased's family is in a state of distress, crying inconsolably. Mourning has spread throughout the village. The incident occurred on Sunday afternoon in the Deoria Kotwali area, 50 km from the district headquarters. Eyewitnesses stated that the young man had entered the river with the tractor to make a REEL. Suddenly, an accident occurred. People standing a short distance away recorded his video, which is now going viral on social media. 3 Photos- Rajesh's family includes wife and 3 innocent children According to the police, Rajesh's family includes wife Rajeshwari, son Aryan (6), Niharika (6) and daughter Neha (4). Rajesh was married in 2018 from Sherganj, Bisalpur police station area. Station House Officer Gautam Singh said- Upon receiving information, police forces reached the spot. After strenuous efforts by divers, the youth was pulled out of the river. He was sent to Deoria CHC in serious condition, where doctors declared him dead after examination. Police have taken possession of the body and sent it for post-mortem. Investigation into the matter has begun.

stories.title: MLA leaves convoy for bullet and e-rickshaw ride:Gets video shot from Fortuner; officer buys ₹8,000 bicycle to commute
stories.summary: BJP MLAs CP Singh and Devendra Singh Lodhi from Bulandshahr traveled in an auto outside the Assembly, but they had the video shot by supporters from a Fortuner. Meanwhile, BJP MLA Shalabh Mani Tripathi from Deoria rode a bike without a helmet. After this, he asked the police to challan himself. Late Sunday night, the police issued him a challan of Rs 1,000. Meanwhile, the Azamgarh DM reached office by e-rickshaw on Monday morning. A gunner was seen sitting in the front seat with a gun. In Meerut, BJP leader and District Panchayat President Gaurav Chaudhary took out a long convoy of tractors on Sunday. A video of the same has surfaced online. In the video, Gaurav Chaudhary can be seen sitting in a tractor. Behind him, a convoy of about 10-12 tractors and a crowd of people can be seen. After the video went viral, he gave a clarification. He said that he was not aware beforehand that the villagers would do this. BJP MP from Bulandshahr, Dr. Bhola Singh, has also purchased a new electric car. He is driving it himself to attend programs. Additionally, BJP MLA from Mirzapur, Pandit Ratnakar Mishra, has bought an electric car, and District Excise Officer from Gonda, Pragalbh Lavaniya, has purchased a bicycle for 8 thousand rupees. Actually, PM Modi had appealed to the countrymen to save petrol-diesel. Following this, the Yogi government also took 7 major decisions 4 days ago to save energy in the state. These include a 50% reduction in the convoys of the Chief Minister, Ministers, MLAs and officers, and requiring them to use public transport or bus-metro once a week. See pictures-

stories.title: Blood-soaked body of patient found at SGPGI:Throat slit with surgical blade in ward; brother sleeping nearby didn't notice
stories.summary: The blood-soaked body of an elderly patient admitted to SGPGI was found on the bed. His throat had been slit with a sharp weapon. A blood-stained surgical blade was also found nearby. It is believed that the patient's throat was slit with the same blade. The police have sent the body for post-mortem. Police, forensic and dog squad have collected evidence. In the initial investigation, the police are considering it as suicide due to distress from illness. However, they are not completely ruling out the possibility of murder either. The police say that all angles are being investigated in detail. The incident occurred early Monday morning in the Liver Transplant Unit (LTU) ward. The deceased has been identified as Mustaq Ali (61), a liver cancer patient. He was a resident of Basti. His own brother Mukhtar Ali, who was sleeping in the same ward, did not even get a hint of it. Brother sleeping on the floor nearby did not hear any sound Mushtaq Ali's real brother Mukhtar Ali was with him in the ward. He was sleeping on the floor near Mushtaq Ali in the ward at night. Mukhtar says that no screaming or sound of any kind was heard at dawn. Nor was there any kind of commotion. According to police, an official memo of the incident was received at quarter to six in the morning. After which police from Hazratganj and the local station reached the spot. Considering the sensitivity of the incident, the Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP), Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police (ADCP) and Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) also inspected the incident site. There are no CCTV cameras inside the ward. There are cameras in other places and corridors. Their footage is being examined. Was admitted on 21st April 61-year-old Mustaq Ali, a resident of Basti, was admitted to the liver transplant wing on 21st April. His treatment was ongoing under Dr. Ashish in the Gastro department. He had liver cancer. SGPGI's PRO Kusum Yadav said that information about Mustaq's death was received this morning. Patient also had heart problems SGPGI's CMS Devendra Gupta said, “Information about the patient's death was received around quarter to six on Monday morning. He was also admitted to my ICU earlier. Apart from cancer, financial constraints were also coming to light.” “He also had some heart problems. His treatment was certainly ongoing but the condition was not good due to advanced stage cancer. Police are investigating. Further details can only be known after investigation.” he added. Vigo was changed 15 minutes earlier Pradyumna, who admitted his relative to the LTU on the same third floor of SGPGI, says that the incident happened at around 4:30 am. The patient's vigo was changed 15 minutes earlier. He was fine then, but later suddenly blood was seen near the bed and it was found that the patient had died. Abhinav Mishra says that his father is admitted on the second floor. Around 5 am in the morning, information was received about a 61-year-old patient's throat being slit. Now it is not known whether he committed suicide or someone else murdered him. This incident has raised a big question on the safety of patients. The mind is very apprehensive. Many times I myself have to leave the patient at night. In such a situation, no one knows what incident might happen with whom and when. Investigation is being done from all angles DCP Amit Kumar Anand said that on Monday early morning between 4-4:30 am, the attendant noticed that blood was coming out from Mushtaq Ali's throat. He informed the hospital staff. On receiving information from the hospital, police also reached the spot. A blade was found near the deceased. Preliminary investigation has revealed that Mushtaq Ali was suffering from liver cancer. His treatment had been going on for the past 8-9 months. He was also going through financial difficulties. The body has been sent for post-mortem. Further legal action will be taken in the case based on investigation of all facts.

stories.title: Husband held for assaulting wife and her boyfriend:Accused had attacked both with sickle after seeing them together in Gorakhpur, lover is a YouTuber
stories.summary: In the Jhangha police station area of Gorakhpur, a man attacked his wife and her acquaintance, a YouTuber, with a sickle. The injured were admitted to AIIMS, after which the police began searching for the accused. On Monday, the police located the accused in the same area. Following this, the police cordoned off the area and arrested the accused Jitendra Nishad. The police are interrogating the accused. In the accused's attack, his wife Gunja's head was split open. Meanwhile, Gunja's acquaintance Kuldeep Sharma's neck and ear were cut. Due to the deep wound on his neck, several stitches were applied. Both are undergoing treatment at AIIMS. The police say that the sharp weapon used in the attack has been recovered from the accused, and he will be presented in court in the afternoon. Now know the complete matter in detail This incident is reported to have occurred around 5:30 PM in Piparpati village of Brahmapur in Jhangha police station area. According to police, Jitendra Nishad of Piparpati village earns his living in Tamil Nadu. His wife Gunja Devi lives at home. Jitendra Nishad had come home from Tamil Nadu just 15 days ago. He had gone out somewhere for some work on Sunday. During this time, Gunja had called her acquaintance Kuldeep Sharma from Shilhata Mundera village in the capital to her home. He had come to the house in an auto around 5 PM in the evening. When Jitendra Nishad came home around 5:30 PM in the evening, he became enraged after seeing his wife with Kuldeep in a room. He first attacked Kuldeep with a sharp weapon kept in the house. In this attack, Kuldeep's neck was cut. He started writhing in pain. After this, he attacked his wife on the head with a stick. This caused Gunja's head to split open. During this time, blood spread all around the room. Seeing all this, Jitendra fled from there. Hearing the screams and shouts, people from the neighborhood also gathered. They informed the Jhangha police. The police who reached the spot have admitted both the injured to AIIMS. Meanwhile, a police team has been deployed to search for the accused Jitendra Nishad. YouTuber has made a video with the woman Villagers said that Jitendra Nishad had seen a video of his wife with Kuldeep a few days ago. After this, there was also a fight between husband and wife. On Sunday, seeing her with Kuldeep, he became angry and launched a deadly attack. Children had gone to maternal uncle's house According to police, Jitendra was married to Gunja of Baghagadha 10 years ago. They have two sons - eight-year-old Shivam and six-year-old Satyam. Both are currently at their maternal uncle's house. In this regard, CO Chauri Chaura Ratneshwar Singh said that on the evening of May 17, around 5:30 pm, a person attacked his wife and her acquaintance YouTuber with a sickle. In this case, a case has been registered and the accused has been arrested.

stories.title: Filth removed after Yogi spots it in aerial survey:Chief Minister had found massive garbage heaps near Barhua Power House in Gorakhpur
stories.summary: Yogi Adityanath’s aerial inspection during a visit to Sahjanwan on Sunday triggered swift action from the Municipal Corporation after the Chief Minister spotted massive garbage heaps near Barhua Power House. The sight of accumulated waste and poor sanitation reportedly drew sharp displeasure from the Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister, prompting officials to immediately launch a large-scale cleanup operation. Garbage spotted during helicopter journey The Chief Minister had arrived in Sahjanwan to attend a party programme when he noticed the filthy stretch surrounding Barhua Power House from his helicopter. Officials said garbage had been lying there for several days, leading to worsening sanitary conditions in the area. The matter gained urgency soon after the CM’s reaction reached civic authorities. Municipal team swings into action Within hours, the Municipal Corporation deployed JCB machines, sanitation workers and several vehicles to the site. Teams began clearing the waste and transporting it to the designated dumping ground. Key actions taken included: Residents welcome sudden cleanup drive Locals said the area had been suffering from foul smell and unhygienic conditions for a long time, especially during summer and monsoon months. Residents claimed repeated garbage dumping had made daily life difficult for people living nearby. Many expressed relief after the cleanup drive finally began following the Chief Minister’s intervention. Officials tighten monitoring measures Senior officials later inspected the site and directed staff to ensure that garbage is not dumped there again. Additional Municipal Commissioner Pramod Kumar said all waste near Barhua Power House had been removed and monitoring responsibility had now been assigned to the local village head. Authorities also issued fresh instructions for regular sanitation checks.

stories.title: More than 33,000 Varanasi homes complete self-census:Physical verification campaign to start across district from next week
stories.summary: Varanasi’s ambitious self-census campaign is picking up momentum, with more than 33,000 households already completing house listing and self-enumeration since the drive began on May 7. The online registration exercise will continue till May 21, leaving residents with only three days to complete the process before the next phase begins. District Magistrate Satyendra Kumar has appealed to citizens to participate actively, describing the census as far more than a routine administrative exercise. Census seen as nation-building exercise Calling the census a critical pillar of policy planning and governance, Kumar said self-enumeration allows citizens to directly register their information, ensuring greater transparency, accuracy and unbiased data collection. He also urged residents to motivate neighbours and relatives to complete the process within the deadline. Ground verification begins from May 22 From May 22 to June 20, trained enumerators and supervisors will conduct door-to-door verification across the district. Key arrangements include: The administration has also warned that obstruction or negligence in census work is punishable under the Census Act, 1948. Citizens must answer 33 mandatory questions For the first time, residents have been given the option to complete self-enumeration through the Centre’s official portal. The process includes: Once completed, families receive an 11-digit SE ID, which officials have advised residents to preserve carefully. SE ID to simplify door-to-door survey Officials said families who complete self-enumeration will face a quicker verification process during physical visits by census teams. When enumerators arrive, residents will only need to provide their SE ID for matching and approval of records. The administration has clarified that no bank details, Aadhaar numbers or financial documents will be sought during the census. However, citizens have been advised to verify the official identity cards of enumerators before sharing information.

stories.title: Panchkroshi Parikrama begins in Kashi:Devotees cover holy city worship major temples by covering 84-km-long Yatra in 5 days
stories.summary: With the auspicious beginning of Purushottam month, the Panchkroshi Parikrama Yatra commenced from Sunday in Kashi, the city of Lord Shiva and also known as the Cultural Capital of the country. Sadhus, saints, and thousands of devotees from across the country are participating in this meritorious journey with proper rituals. 84-km-long Panchkroshi Yatra to conclude in 5 days Devotees complete this approximately 84-kilometer-long Panchkroshi Yatra in five days. During the journey, devotees circumambulate Shri Kashi and perform darshan and worship at temples located at five major stops, along with all temples falling on the southern direction of the route. This yatra continues for 30 consecutive days throughout the entire Purushottam month. The yatra begins with a bath in Manikarnika Kund Devotees started arriving in Kashi a day in advance to join the journey. On Pratipada Tithi, devotees took a bath at Manikarnika Ghat, took water from the Kund and took a Sankalp (vow). After this, they started the journey after having darshan of Lord Dandapani, Dhundhiraj Ganesha and Baba Vishwanath. Devotees rest at five designated stops daily Devotees rest at five designated stops daily and reach the final stop Kapildhara, and after darshan of Manikarnika Ghat and Baba Vishwanath again, they complete the journey by abandoning the Sankalp near the Gyanvapi area. Devotees who are unable to undertake the journey on foot are also performing Kashi Parikrama by vehicles. Mahamandaleshwar Swami Ashutoshanand Giri starts journey On the first day, under the leadership of Mahamandaleshwar Swami Ashutoshanand Giri Maharaj of Kailash Math, hundreds of disciples and devotees took a holy dip in the Ganges at Manikarnika Ghat, took a pledge, and formally commenced the auspicious Panchkroshi Yatra. This year ‘No Fuel’ Yatra Inspired by the Prime Minister's call, this year the yatra is being organized on the theme of "No Fuel Yatra". The saint community will walk on foot to convey the message of dharma, restraint, and nature conservation. Mahamandaleshwar Maharaj said that in the present times, the world is going through many crises, and in such a period, Sanatan culture, penance, chanting, and spiritual practice alone can give a new direction to humanity. He called upon devotees to perform morning bath, tarpan (offering to ancestors), lamp donation, Vishnu Sahasranama Stotra, Shiva Mahimna Stotra, and recitation of Srimad Bhagavad Gita during Purushottam month.
