stories.title: Daughter accused in ₹1.20 crore robbery breaks down in jail:Sister told her brother she felt suffocated in prison; boyfriend had allegedly planned the robbery
stories.summary: A 21-year-old woman arrested for helping her boyfriend plan a robbery at her businessman father’s house in Moradabad is now crying continuously inside jail and regretting her actions. Police said the accused, Ariba, breaks down almost every night and keeps asking to return home. Ariba was arrested for allegedly helping in the robbery of ₹1.20 crore cash and 6 tola gold from her father’s house. According to jail officials, she is eating very little food and spends most of her time weeping. Female guards and other inmates try to calm her, but she starts crying again after some time. Officials said Ariba repeatedly tells jail staff that she wants to meet her parents and go back home. She also says she is unable to live peacefully inside the jail. During a recent jail visit, Ariba hugged her brother and started crying. She told him that she had made a very big mistake and begged him to somehow take her home. She also asked her family to forgive her and said she feels suffocated inside the jail. Sources said her family has now started trying for her bail, but legal experts believe it may not be easy because of the serious nature of the case. Jail officials said Ariba was extremely disturbed when she was brought to jail on Thursday and cried throughout the night. Officials added that because of her mental condition, she is being kept under close watch inside the jail. Even during the following nights, she reportedly continued crying at intervals and remained awake for most of the night after sleeping briefly during the day. Ariba told the female inmates - My family will not get me out. Jail officials said that there are a total of 78 female inmates in the women's barracks in the jail. Ariba is also trying to mingle among them. The female inmates explain to Ariba that don't worry, your bail will be granted soon and you will be released from here. However, Ariba starts crying even at this reassurance. She says - I betrayed my family. I betrayed my mom-dad and brothers. That's why they probably won't get me out of here. They will never forgive me. However, after her brother visited her in jail, Ariba has gained hope that her family will help her. Her brother told Ariba that efforts are being made to get her bail. Since then, Ariba is trying to be somewhat normal. Ariba was the most beloved child of her parents Ariba was the most beloved child in her family. Her father, brass businessman Imran, and mother Seema loved Ariba very much. Her other daughter Aliza did not have as much freedom as Ariba did. Both brothers, Arib and Arkan, also doted on their sister. The family never even dreamt that their most beloved daughter could commit such an act. 8-year affair, family was not ready for marriage On May 11, at 3:40 AM, a robbery of 1.20 crore cash and 6 tola gold occurred at the house of a brass businessman in the Akbar Compound area, Nagphani police station. The police revealed this on May 14. The robbery was plotted by the businessman's daughter, Ariba, along with her boyfriend. Their affair had been going on for 8 years. Both wanted to get married, but the businessman and his family were not ready for it. After this, both conspired together. The boyfriend's 7 friends supported him. All of them are pursuing B. Pharma from the same college. 6 miscreants entered the house, took the businessman and son at gunpoint In Moradabad, brass businessman Imran lives with his family in the Akbar Compound area, within the Nagphani police station jurisdiction. His family includes his wife Seema and 4 children: Arib (26), Arkan (23), Ariba (21), and Aliza (19). On May 11, at 3:40 AM, Imran's house was robbed of 1.20 crore cash and 6 tolas of jewellery. 6 miscreants entered the house and committed the crime by holding a pistol to the temples of the businessman and his son, Arib. Within minutes, the miscreants fled the scene in two cars after looting the cash and jewellery. Imran's house has a digital lock. The miscreants neither broke the digital lock nor entered the house through any other route. Not even a sound of them entering the house was heard. Additionally, the miscreants also had precise information about the 1.2 crore rupees cash kept in the house. As soon as they arrived, they questioned the brass businessman about the cash. In such a situation, it was suspected that a member of the household was involved with the miscreants. Ariba's Mobile Details and CCTV Revealed the Secret Just two days after the incident, on Thursday, May 14, the police arrested Ariba, the daughter of a brass businessman, her boyfriend Arshad Warsi, and her 3 other associates, thereby exposing the crime. 47 lakh rupees from the looted amount, 2 cars used in the crime, and 4 country-made pistols were also recovered. SSP Satpal Antil said- Since the incident, the police were engaged in investigating the case. With the help of CCTV footage and electronic surveillance, the police reached the businessman's daughter Ariba and arrested her. During interrogation, she provided information about all the criminals involved in the robbery. She also stated that she herself had opened the digital locks installed in the house by pressing the buzzer button located on the first floor of the house, near her bedroom. Police arrested Ariba, her boyfriend Arshad Warsi, and three other accused: Kuldeep (26), Ravi (26), and Nikki (2). All the accused are studying B-Pharma at the Institute of Foreign Trade and Management (IFTM University), Moradabad. Meanwhile, Ariba has studied up to 12th grade. She stays at home. Used to give sleeping pills to family members Ariba had an affair with Arshad Warsi, a resident of Amroha, for about 7-8 years. Both had sworn to live and die together. But, due to different castes, Ariba's family was not ready for this marriage. However, Ariba had made up her mind that she wanted to live with Arshad Warsi. Ariba used to meet her lover constantly. When her family stopped her from meeting him, she often gave sleeping pills to her family, put them into a deep sleep, and met Arshad. She also used to call him home. The entire planning was Ariba's, she gave the main gate key to her boyfriend During police interrogation, Ariba revealed - According to the plan, about a month ago, I got a key made for the main gate. I gave this key to Arshad. I told Arshad that he would open the main gate with this key and come inside the house. After this, I would open the second digital lock of the house by pressing the button inside the house. Then Arshad would easily enter the house with his companions. Before going to jail, when Ariba was asked if the entire planning of this incident was hers, she nodded her head in affirmation.

stories.title: Yogi cabinet clears backward commission for Panchayat polls:Allowance of veterinary doctors increased by ₹8,000 and Lucknow Metro expansion also approved
stories.summary: For the first time after the cabinet expansion, a meeting was held on Monday under the chairmanship of CM Yogi in Lucknow. In this, 12 proposals were approved, including the expansion of Lucknow Metro. The formation of an OBC commission for conducting Panchayat elections has been approved. The High Court had ordered the formation of the commission. Panchayat elections will be held in the state only after the commission's report. In addition, the internship allowance for students studying veterinary medicine has been increased from 8 thousand to 12 thousand rupees. Earlier, they used to get 4 thousand rupees every month. About 2,000 to 2,500 students get admission every year in BVSc AH (Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry) in the colleges of the state. Including all batches, more than 10 thousand veterinary students are studying in UP.

stories.title: Premanand Maharaj health deteriorates, padyatra suspended:Private Darshan stopped for an indefinite period; disciples request devotees to return
stories.summary: The health of Saint Premanand Maharaj has worsened, due to which his night pilgrimage has been postponed indefinitely. His private darshan has also been suspended for now. On Sunday night, thousands of devotees reached for his darshan. However, Premanandji did not begin the pilgrimage at 3 AM as he usually does. Instead, his disciples arrived in his place and informed devotees about the change. The disciples announced via loudspeaker: We request everyone that due to Maharajji's ill health, the pilgrimage is being canceled from today. Please do not gather by standing on the roadside. After this, devotees had to return disappointed without having Maharajji's darshan. According to Kelly Kunj Ashram, Maharajji has been suffering from kidney problems for 21 years. See 2 pictures- Devotees said - We pray to Radha that Maharajji gets well soon. Maharaj walks one and a half km Saint Premanand Maharaj these days leaves Kelly Kunj Ashram for Saubhari Van at 3 AM. He walks 1.5 km. Thousands of devotees arrive to have darshan of Premanand Maharaj. On normal days, this number is around 20,000. On weekends and major festivals, the number of devotees coming for darshan increases manifold, reaching into lakhs. Now, the story of Saint Premanand Maharaj Left home at the age of 13 Premanand Maharaj was born in Akhri village, Narwal tehsil, Kanpur district, Uttar Pradesh. His father is Shambhu Narayan Pandey and his mother is Rama Devi. He has 3 brothers, Premanand is the middle one. In childhood, Premanand ji's name was Anirudh Kumar Pandey. He was spiritual from childhood. He studied up to class 8. In his childhood, Anirudh wanted to build a platform for a Shiva temple with his group of friends. He also started its construction, but some people stopped it. This made him sad. His heart was so broken that he decided to leave home. He reached Kashi via Kanpur. When he turned 13, he decided to become a celibate (Brahmachari). Initially, Premanand Maharaj's name was 'Aryan Brahmachari'. He spent about 15 months in Kashi. He received initiation (Gurudiksha) from Guru Gauri Sharan Ji Maharaj. Then he came to Mathura. Premanand Maharaj transformed from a Sanyasi to a Radhavallabhi Saint Upon reaching Vrindavan, Premanand Maharaj would visit Banke Bihari Ji every day. Then he became fond of Rasleela and started attending Radhavallabh programs. He would stand there for hours. One day, a saint recited a verse from Shri Radharasudhanidhi, but Maharaj could not understand it. Then one day, while circumambulating Vrindavan, he heard a Sakhi singing a verse. Hearing her, the king paused. The verse pleased him so much that he broke his ascetic vows and went to that friend (sakh?). He asked her for the meaning of the verse. The friend said, "To understand its meaning, one must be a Radhavallabhi." Thus, the king became a Radhavallabhi.

stories.title: ‘Kyu Mangey Udhaar Jab Apna Neta Taiyaar’:Chirag's posters spark buzz in UP, Bihar parties to contest polls; tough test ahead for Sanjay Nishad
stories.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Chirag Paswan’s Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) has started showing its strength in Lucknow through new posters and political messages. The posters carry the slogan, “Why should leaders ask for loans, when our own leader is ready.” In the posters, Chirag Paswan is seen standing with folded hands. Pictures of several senior party leaders have also been included. The move is being seen as the party’s effort to increase its presence in Uttar Pradesh politics. Party MP and senior leader Arun Bharti told Dainik Bhaskar that the party’s focus is not only on Bihar but also on Uttar Pradesh. He said the party is preparing to contest all 403 seats in the 2027 Assembly elections. At the same time, Mukesh Sahani, who is known for raising issues related to the Nishad community, is also preparing for elections in eastern Uttar Pradesh. He is expected to field candidates on seats where the Nishad community has a strong presence. Read a special report on the entry of Bihar's parties into UP politics The discussion of Bihar's parties in UP politics started after 2 incidents- First- when posters of Lok Janshakti Party (Ram Vilas) were put up in Lucknow, outside the CM's residence, near the Assembly, at Atal Chowk and Hazratganj. In these, Chirag Paswan is standing with folded hands. Behind him is a crowd of people. The poster also features pictures of prominent leaders associated with the party. Second- Mukesh Sahani, who does Nishad community politics in Bihar, is strengthening his roots by holding VIP worker conferences in the districts of Purvanchal. He asks if Nishads received reservation? If not, why doesn't Sanjay Nishad resign from BJP? First, let's talk about Chirag Paswan's Lok Janshakti Party's preparations to contest elections in UP. Regarding this, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to LJP (R)'s number-2 and Jamui MP Arun Bharti Question- Chirag Paswan's posters have been put up in Lucknow, what does this mean? Answer- The party's entire focus is on UP. We are working on organisational expansion in UP. The party will be strengthened at the booth level. Large-scale programs will be held across the state. Question- What will be at the center of politics? Answer- The party will raise the voice of Dalits, the deprived, and weaker sections. Question- Will you contest elections in UP? Will you also form an alliance? Answer- Currently, we do not have any alliance with anyone in UP. We are going to contest elections on all 403 seats. Question- You have an alliance with BJP at the center. Will this not happen in UP? Answer- LJP has an alliance with BJP at the center, not at the UP level. However, seat-sharing talks with NDA could happen at the last minute. We will see that later. Chirag Paswan's party is a kingmaker in Bihar Chirag Paswan's party is quite strong in Bihar. He himself is the Food Processing Minister in the central government. In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Chirag Paswan's party got 5 seats in Bihar from the NDA alliance. Chirag's party won all seats with a 100% strike rate. Chirag himself won from Hajipur and Arun Bharti won from Jamui. This proved that Bihar's 'Paswan/Dusadh' vote bank is completely with Chirag. This constitutes 5-6% of the total vote bank. In the Bihar Assembly elections held in November 2025, LJP (R)'s performance was also excellent. The party won 19 out of the 29 seats allotted by the NDA alliance. Today, Chirag's party has become the third-largest force in Bihar after JDU-BJP. 'Chirag' will target many districts of UP The total Scheduled Caste (SC) population in UP is approximately 21%. This is about 4.13 crore. The largest share, about 54-56%, belongs to the Jatav/Chamar community. The second largest share, about 16%, belongs to the Pasi community. In addition, castes like Dhobi, Kori, Valmiki, and Dhanuk are also included. Chirag Paswan's party LJP (R) will make these its base for politics. LJP (R)'s main focus is on Purvanchal and districts bordering Bihar, where the population of Dalits (especially Pasi and non-Jatav communities) and backward classes is high. Is this a game to form a National Party or an expansion of the organisation? Chirag Paswan does not want to limit his party only to Bihar. He wants to get it the status of a National Party. This is why he is becoming active in other states as well. Besides UP, his party has also contested elections in Jharkhand, Jammu and Kashmir, and Nagaland. According to the Election Commission, for any party to become a National Party, it must fulfill one of these conditions. In UP politics, Dalit (SC) and Nishad (OBC) vote banks have always been game-changers. In such a situation, the arrival of Chirag Paswan and Mukesh Sahani can change the equations of the state. Chirag Paswan will focus on Dalit (especially Paswan) voters. He will also benefit from his youth image. This could potentially dent BSP's traditional Dalit vote. Meanwhile, Mukesh Sahani's VIP party advocates for the rights of Nishad, Mallah, Kashyap, and Bind communities. In UP, Sanjay Nishad leads the politics of the Nishad-Mallah community. He is currently a cabinet minister in the Yogi government. In the 2022 elections, Nishad Party contested more than 11 seats in alliance with BJP. It won 6 seats directly on its symbol (food plate). These seats include Majhwan of Mirzapur, Gyanpur of Bhadohi, Katehari of Ambedkar Nagar and Tumkuhi Raj of Kushinagar. Now VIP can also be seen on these seats against Sanjay Nishad. Because, Sanjay Nishad will contest the elections in alliance with BJP. In such a situation, it is believed that the Samajwadi Party can support Bihar's VIP party.

stories.title: Obsessed lover turns out to be killer of Meerut student:Girl went to give exam before attack; mobile message pleaded ‘please save me God’
stories.summary: A 20-year-old student was murdered in Meerut, allegedly by an obsessed lover and his friends. Police arrested the main accused late on Sunday night. During questioning, he admitted that he had been friends with the student for the past three years. He told police that he became angry after seeing her talking to another boy, which led to an argument. Later, he and his friends allegedly killed her. According to police, the student had left home on May 15 to appear for her BA third-year examination, but did not return by evening. Her family searched for her and later filed a missing person complaint at the police station the same day. On May 17, the student’s decomposed body was found in a sugarcane field nearly 25 km away from her home. After the body was recovered, angry family members protested outside the police station. They accused the accused of gang rape and murder. Police assured the family that strict action would be taken and registered a case against three youths based on the complaint. Late Sunday night, police arrested the main accused, Ankush, from his house, while two other accused are still absconding. Police also recovered a note from the student’s mobile phone which read, “Please save me God,” indicating that she may have been in fear before her death. The case is related to the TP Nagar police station area in Meerut. A note was found in the girl's mobile, read what it says... Today, on 11/05/26, I am going to take the exam, but I am feeling very strange. I don't know why, but I have this feeling deep inside. God, I beg you with folded hands, please don't let anything go wrong. Please, please, please God, my home will fall apart. God, I implore you, please keep everything alright. My mother, father, and siblings won't be able to live without me. They feel lost without me, I don't know why, even as I write this, my tears are flowing. Read the full case chronologically The father of the student, who resides in Meerut's TP Nagar police station area, is a tailor. The family includes the student's mother, sister, and younger brother. On May 15, the student had gone to a degree college to take the Political Science exam, but did not return home until late evening. The family members called her friends. They inquired at the college, but the girl could not be found. After this, the family filed a missing person report at the TP Nagar police station late in the evening. Police started searching for the girl. On Sunday, May 17, the girl's body was found in a sugarcane field in Ukasia village, under the Rohta police station area. A young man from the village saw the body. After this, the police were called. The student's face had been eaten by insects. It also seemed as if an attempt had been made to burn the body with acid after the murder. However, no signs of struggle were found at the crime scene. In such a situation, the police suspected that the girl was murdered elsewhere and then her body was dumped here. Police called the family members and identified the body. Seeing the body, the family members created a ruckus at the police station. The student's father alleged that if the TP Nagar police had listened in time, his daughter's life would have been saved. He accused three boys of gang-raping and murdering his daughter. Police assured the family members of action against the three. Following this, a case was registered against the deranged Ankush and his two friends Nishant and Ankit, based on the family's complaint. SSP Avinash Pandey said- When the police started the investigation, the girl was seen leaving in CCTV footage. Based on the family's suspicion and evidence, Ankush's name came forward. Five police teams were formed. Ankush was taken into custody. During interrogation, he confessed to the murder. The remaining two accused will also be apprehended as soon as possible.The picture is from the post-mortem house. The police had taken information about the incident from the family.The madman had been harassing the daughter for 2 years, now he has killed her.The father said - Accused Ankush had been harassing his daughter for a long time. He used to follow her. 2 years ago, Ankush tried to kidnap the daughter. The daughter had told us about this. After this, a panchayat was held. Then Ankush apologized in front of everyone, but later started harassing the daughter again. Fed up with his actions, we left the village 6 months ago. We started living in a rented room on Rohta Road in Meerut, but he did not stop following the daughter. Now he has killed the daughter.Chandrashekhar Azad said - Government should provide assistance to the victim's familyOn the matter,Azad Samaj Party chief Chandrashekhar Azad wrote on X - The government should provide assistance to the victim's family and arrest the accused.

stories.title: Deadly road crash in Uttar Pradesh claims 10 lives:Teacher and engineer among victims; truck hit van carrying several passengers
stories.summary: Ten people were killed after a Magic vehicle collided with a truck at around 7.30 am on Monday in Lakhimpur Kheri. All the victims were travelling in the Magic vehicle. Nine people died on the spot, while one later died in hospital. The dead included a government school teacher and an engineer. The accident happened near Adlispur village on the Pilibhit-Basti Highway, around 40km from the district headquarters. Eyewitnesses said the Magic vehicle was travelling from Lakhimpur towards Sisaiya when it was hit head-on by a speeding truck coming from Bahraich. The truck driver fled from the scene after the crash. The collision was so severe that several passengers suffered fatal head injuries and became trapped between the seats. Two people were thrown out onto the road. Local residents informed the police, who later sent the bodies for post-mortem examination. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over the accident and announced financial assistance of ₹2 lakh each for the families of the deceased. Truck seized, driver absconding Khamaria Circle Officer Shamsher Bahadur Singh said the truck (UP 14 HT 5176) is registered in the name of Sher Singh, a resident of Nagla Faridpur in Bareilly. He is the second owner of the truck. The vehicle carried a Ghaziabad number plate and was loaded with sacks of rice polish. Police have seized the truck and launched a search for the driver. CHC Khamaria superintendent Dr Amit Kumar Singh said the bodies of two women and seven men were brought to the hospital after the accident. Several bodies were badly crushed. One seriously injured man was referred to the district hospital, but he died on the way. Village head blames overtaking attempt Eyewitness and village head of Naya Gaon, Pradeep Verma, said the condition of the Magic vehicle suggested the driver may have been trying to overtake another vehicle when it collided with the speeding truck coming from the opposite direction. He said nine passengers died inside the vehicle immediately after the crash, while one young man was still alive and struggling. Locals broke open the gate of the vehicle to pull him out and sent him to the hospital in an ambulance, but he later died. Nine victims identified, one yet to be identified Police said nine of the ten victims have been identified so far. The deceased included two brothers, Pawan (23) and Sohan (21), residents of Moorteeha village in Bahraich. Adnan (15), a resident of Sisaiya village in the Dhaurahara area of Kheri district, also died in the crash. Other victims included Pappu (18) from Devdattpur in Bahraich, Shahzad (35) from Kakraha Moorteeha in Bahraich, and Julekha (55) from Dhaurahara in Kheri district. The identity of one victim is still being confirmed. Government teacher, engineer and businessman among the dead Gayatri, 44, was a resident of Vijay Lakshmi Nagar in Sitapur and worked as a government teacher at a primary school in Mihimpurwa, Bahraich. She had left home in the morning to go to school. Jaiveer Singh, 25, from Man Gothiya village in Bahraich, worked as an engineer in a power company in Mumbai. He had resigned from his job on 16 May after securing a new job in Qatar. Rajesh Goyal, 54, from Mihimpurwa in Bahraich, ran a business supplying ghee, oil and sugar. He had come to Lakhimpur to visit his brother-in-law, Pawan Singhal and was returning to Bahraich when the accident happened. Engineer was preparing to leave for Qatar Jaiveer Singh’s father, Peshkar Singh, is a retired Home Guard officer. His uncle Jitendra said Jaiveer had resigned from his Mumbai company on 16 May because he had received a new job offer in Qatar. He was scheduled to fly from Pune to Qatar on 21 May and was returning home to meet his family before leaving. His younger brother Prakash Singh said Jaiveer was the only earning member of the family. “This accident has taken away our only support,” he said.

stories.title: US fitness influencer amazed by Brij Bhushan’s lavish estate:Explored a Helicopter, rode ₹2.5 crore horse; later fired 2 rounds from a rifle
stories.summary: American fitness icon and social media influencer Ashton Hall reached Gonda for a two-day visit. During the visit, he met former BJP MP Brijbhushan Singh and his MP son Karan Bhushan Singh. Ashton Hall was surprised after seeing Brijbhushan Singh’s 15-acre mansion and his helicopter. On Sunday morning, around 8 AM, Karan Bhushan took Ashton Hall to the Nandini Nagar Shooting Range. There, Ashton Hall showed interest in shooting. Karan Bhushan gave him a rifle and explained some shooting tips. Ashton Hall then fired two shots. Called Karan Bhushan 'Boss' Ashton noticed the 'B' written on Karan Bhushan's slippers. In a lighthearted manner, Ashton said 'B' meant 'Boss'. People started laughing at this. Ashton Hall exercised in the gym by lifting Brijbhushan's Hanuman Gada. Ashton could not lift the Hanuman Gada in the initial 2 attempts. He succeeded in the third attempt. Ashton also played cricket with children. He chanted 'Khelo India' and 'Bharat Mata ki Jai' slogans. He rode horses worth two and a half crore. Ashton has 18 million followers on Instagram. See pictures Ashton Hall also visited Brijbhushan Singh's stable. Ashton Hall on India Visit American influencer Ashton Hall is currently on a visit to India. He is meeting personalities associated with various sports and cultural activities in India. He is capturing these experiences on his camera and sharing them on social media. On Sunday morning, Ashton Hall reached the Nandini Nagar Shooting Range. Here, MP Karan Bhushan Singh welcomed him. He was taken to the shooting range and taught shooting. After this, MP Karan Bhushan took him to his house. Here he was shown the helicopter, house, and stable. Ashton Hall also enjoyed horse riding. Ashton Hall got excited seeing the mace Karan showed his father Brijbhushan Sharan Singh's gym. Ashton Hall was very happy to see the Hanuman mace kept there. He started exercising by lifting the mace. Ashton Hall and Yogendra Kushwaha highly praised Karan Bhushan Singh for this entire meeting. Both expressed their happiness by coming to Gonda and gaining experience in shooting. Ashton Hall is unmatched in terms of fitness MP Karan Bhushan Singh said, Ashton Hall is unmatched in terms of fitness. People keep learning something or the other from him. Upon his arrival in Gonda, I welcomed him. Taught him shooting. Arranged horse riding. Also showed him my home. After this, Ashton Hall departed with his team. Met the wrestlers undergoing training Brijbhushan Sharan Singh took Ashton Hall to the Wrestling Training Centre of the Indian Wrestling Federation. There, he met the wrestlers who were training. He took pictures with them. Ashton Hall gave fitness tips to the children. Motivated them to train diligently Brijbhushan Sharan Singh and Ashton Hall gave wrestling kits to several wrestlers. They motivated them to train diligently. Later, Ashton Hall played cricket with the children on the grounds of Nandini Nagar Mahavidyalaya. Brijbhushan Sharan Singh said that the guest from America has been welcomed. He met the children learning wrestling, distributed kits, and later departed to see his (the guest's) house, helicopter, and horses. He said, local children and people also warmly welcomed Ashton Hall.

stories.title: Severe heatwave grips 33 districts across UP:IMD advises people to stay indoors; CM Yogi asks officials to monitor situation on ground
stories.summary: The heat in Uttar Pradesh is increasing day by day, with many districts, including Bundelkhand, facing severe heatwave conditions. Strong sunlight was seen across almost all districts since Monday morning, while slow wind movement increased humidity and discomfort among people. The India Meteorological Department has issued a heatwave alert for 33 districts today. IMD says that people should remain alert. Do not step out of the house during the afternoon. Take special care of the elderly, children, and sick people. Drink as much water as possible and wear light cotton clothes. CM Yogi has also instructed all District Magistrates, the Health Department, the Electricity Department, and relief agencies to remain in alert mode. He also asked to keep ambulance services active. The CM has instructed officials to go into the field, keep special vigil on sensitive districts, and complete relief and rescue preparations in a timely manner. Arrangements have been asked to be made for the treatment of patients affected by heatstroke in government hospitals. Instructions have also been given to ensure the arrangement of drinking water in public places and an uninterrupted power supply. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda was the hottest city in the country. The temperature here was recorded at 46.4 °C. Out of the 24 hottest cities in the country, 4 districts of UP were included. Besides Banda, this includes Jhansi (44.6 °C), Prayagraj (44.5 °C), and Hamirpur (44.2 °C). Water was sprinkled on the roads in Kanpur. Coolers were installed in stables in Prayagraj. The elephant was repeatedly bathed at Gorakhpur Zoo.

stories.title: Beheaded body of young woman recovered from train in Lucknow:Police found torso in a box and body parts in a bag; head still missing
stories.summary: On Sunday, a headless body of a young woman was found on the Gomtinagar Express, which travels from Chhapra, Bihar to Lucknow. The body, found in a sleeper coach, was enclosed in a box. The young woman's hands and feet were packed in polythene. The head has not yet been found. Upon receiving information, GRP and RPF arrived at the scene. GRP has registered a case and started an investigation. The case pertains to coach S-1 of train number 15114 at Gomtinagar station. See 2 pictures Now the sequence of events in detail Train number 15114 runs between Chhapra and Gomtinagar. The train departed from Chhapra at 5:45 PM on May 16 and reached Gomtinagar Railway Station at 6 AM on Sunday. During cleaning in coach S-1, staff found a suspicious bag and box. The staff informed the station superintendent about this. After this, GRP and RPF were called. GRP in-charge of Charbagh, Dharamveer Singh, said that upon reaching the spot with the team, the box was opened. It contained the torso of a young woman, aged around 30-35 years. Neither the head has been found yet, nor has the identity of the young woman been established. Her hands and feet were found packed in a polythene bag. The body has been sent for post-mortem. The young woman was wearing a colourful suit The young woman found in the box was wearing a colourful suit. Seeing this, it is suspected that the young woman might be from a village. At first glance, it appears that the young woman was cut with a sharp weapon. It is suspected that the killer might have used a cleaver, typically used in slaughterhouses. However, no signs of struggle or injury were found on the young woman's body. Meanwhile, the body was packed in the box in such a way that the bloodstains remained inside and were not visible outside. The hands and feet were also in polythene, and no blood was visible from that either. Team formed for identification, passengers to be questioned A team has been formed for the identification of the young woman's body, which will investigate by questioning passengers in the bogie and also from stations along the route. In fact, the Chhapra-Gomtinagar Express train passes through a total of 20 stations. This train completes its journey in about 12 hours. In such a situation, GRP will check the CCTV of all stations on the route. Those who boarded the bogie with boxes will be investigated using CCTV. Details of passengers traveling in S-1 bogie with reservations will be taken and they will be interrogated.

stories.title: Banda becomes country’s hottest district:57,000 tonnes of sand extracted daily from Ken River; 25% hills already lost
stories.summary: Banda has once again recorded extreme heat. On May 16, the district became the hottest place in Uttar Pradesh with the temperature touching 44.8°C. Earlier, on April 27, Banda was also recorded as the hottest district in the country when the mercury reached 47.6°C. Experts say this is not happening suddenly, but is linked to the fast destruction of natural resources in the area. According to experts, Banda’s environment is getting damaged every year. In the last 10 years, nearly 20% to 25% of the hills in the district have either disappeared or more than half of them have been broken. At the same time, around 2,000 trucks of sand are being taken out daily from the Ken River. This is equal to nearly 57,000 tonnes of sand every day. A study published in the science magazine ‘Journal of Extension Systems’ claims that 13.72% of Banda’s forest area is being cut every year. However, new trees are not being planted in the same numbers. Experts warn that if natural resources continue to be destroyed at this speed, Banda could turn barren in the next 20 to 25 years. To understand the ground situation, we visited Kewatra village, which is around 6 km from Banda city. The route passes through Babulal Chauraha and Padmakar Chauraha. The Ken River flows near the village. Our team parked the car 100 meters away. After this, we walked to the riverbank. Here, people were extracting sand from the river while sitting in boats. Some people were coming to the riverbank with sand. After this, the sand was being loaded into mini dumpers and taken towards the top of the riverbank. Now, whether this work is happening with government permission or illegally, no one there was found to tell. Mountains are slowly being destroyed, there is also fear of mafia here After witnessing the plight of the Ken River in Kewatra village, we reached Girwa village, 35 km away. This road passes through Babulal Chauraha and Atarra Chungi. Blasting was being done in the hills here. A plant for breaking stones to make gravel was also visible. Meanwhile, the laborers working there also told us about the mining mafia. Hearing this, our team parked the bike there, as a slight mistake could have been fatal. Walking about 500 meters, we reached the spot where the mountain was being broken. Here, blasting was being done by placing explosives in the hills. Crusher machines were installed at some distance. With their help, stones were being broken to make gravel. We captured all this on our camera. Ken River is being riddled with holes in Rajghat Leaving Girwa, we reached Rajghat directly. The distance between the two is about 42 Km. This route passes through Atarra Chungi, Chhoti Bazaar, and Khutla Rahuniya. People said that Rajghat is surrounded by bushes. It is also quite narrow. Therefore, mining activities here go unnoticed by people. Dainik Bhaskar's team walked along the river bank and reached the Duredi mine. Here, Poclain machines were extracting sand (maurung) from the river. These machines were blocking the river's flow to extract sand. After that, the sand was being loaded into trucks and dumpers. According to the rules of the National Green Tribunal (NGT) and the Mining Department, extracting sand from the riverbed using Poclain or heavy machinery is banned. Abhishek Shukla, a journalist from Banda, states - In Girwa, Patraha, and Jarar villages of Naraini tehsil, 16 companies are breaking mountains. An equal number of companies are producing gravel. Mining mafias are drilling 2 to 4 inches instead of the prescribed 1 inch for blasting. Dust and smoke spread like a blanket in the air. They prevent the earth's heat from rising. These dust particles also settle on plants and the ground. This causes the soil's moisture to disappear. Ken River drying up due to sand mining Umashankar Pandey, who received the Padma Shri for water conservation in Banda, explains - The Ken River originates from Satna (Madhya Pradesh). It is a total of 427 km long. Sand mining takes place in about 100 km of the stretch that flows through Banda. Mining mafias do not follow the rules of the Environment Department and the Mining Department. Extracting sand from rivers with excavators (Poclain) is prohibited, but it is happening rampantly. Sand mining also removes sand. The land becomes stony. This causes water to flow away instead of staying. Cutting of trees is also increasing the heat Millions of trees were cut down to build the Bundelkhand Expressway, which started in 2022. The UP Forest Department stated in an RTI in December 2020 that a total of 1 lakh 89 thousand 36 trees were cut for the Bundelkhand Expressway. Thousands of trees were also cut in Banda, which was part of this project. A study was conducted in 2025 regarding Banda's forest area. It revealed that Banda's total forest area decreased by 15.54%. Meanwhile, dense forests saw a reduction of 17.55%. This study was published on ResearchGate by researchers from Banda Agriculture University, Bareilly's Ruhelkhand University, Lucknow University, and Varanasi's BHU. stories.title: Retirement age of 1.43 lakh Shiksha Mitras might become 62:Suggestions sought from all BSAs of UP; 26 people had written letter to govt
stories.summary: Preparations have begun to increase the retirement age of Shiksha Mitras in UP from 60 to 62 years. Several Shiksha Mitras had demanded service extension from the government similar to that of assistant teachers. Following this, the Director General of School Education and the State Project Director's office have sought suggestions from Basic Education officers. Additional State Project Director Prem Ranjan Singh has sent letters on May 21 to BSAs of several districts, including Auraiya, Basti, Ballia, Kanpur Nagar, Lucknow, Raebareli, Jaunpur, Gonda, Lakhimpur Kheri, and Shahjahanpur. In this, opinions have been sought on extending the service period of Shiksha Mitras who have completed 60 years of service. There are 1.43 lakh Shiksha Mitras in UP. From April 1, the current government has increased the honorarium of Shiksha Mitras from ₹10 thousand to ₹18 thousand. Demand on the lines of Assistant Teachers The appointment order of Shiksha Mitras mentions retirement upon completing 60 years of age. 26 Shiksha Mitras have written a letter to the government. They have argued that Assistant Teachers were also earlier retired at the age of 60 years. The government has given them service extension and has now made a rule to retire at the age of 62 years. Shiksha Mitras also come under the category of Assistant Teachers. In such a situation, their retirement age limit should also be increased from 60 to 62 years. These 26 Shiksha Mitras wrote the letter Imra Khatun from Gonda, Anju Dwivedi from Lucknow, Nizamuddin from Unnao, Kaushalya from Ambedkar Nagar, Gayatri Singh from Jaunpur, Devendra Kumar from Hathras, Seema Mishra from Lucknow BKT have written a letter to the government. Apart from these, Sharda Prasad from Lakhimpur Kheri, Ramnath Singh from Gonda, Nazim Ali from Badaun, Shashi Prabha from Lalitpur, Suresh Chand from Shahjahanpur, Devki Devi from Kanpur Dehat, Ramjatan Prasad from Maharajganj, Shanta Devi from Firozabad, Ishwar Singh from Moradabad, Hirawati from Jaunpur, Lakhan Singh from Shikohabad, Urmila from Gonda, Rajpal from Badaun, Rajendra from Basti, Rajesh Kumar from Jaunpur, Lalman from Hamirpur, Premvati from Auraiya, and Hariprakash from Maharajganj are included. These Shiksha Mitras said that, like them, there are many other Shiksha Mitras who are about to complete 60 years of age. Know how important Shiksha Mitras are in UP politics? Actually, political experts believe that one Shiksha Mitra influences 10 voters in UP. In this way, through 1.68 lakh Shiksha Mitras and instructors, BJP is trying to bring about 17 lakh voters to its side. Not only this, but the BJP's effort is to find an answer to the questions being raised about the merger of government schools. Meanwhile, sensing the political risk, SP is engaged in setting a narrative against it. Capacity to change equations in 43 assembly seats Shiksha Mitras, with the support of their families and social networks, have a decisive impact on more than 43 seats in the state. The number of Shiksha Mitras and instructors in UP is around 1.68 lakh. According to political experts, one Shiksha Mitra influences 10 voters, including their family, relatives, and neighborhood. By this calculation, Shiksha Mitras and instructors have an influence on 16.80 lakh voters. This means, on average, 4 thousand voters under their influence are present on every assembly seat. In the 2022 assembly elections, there were around 43 such seats where the victory-defeat margin was less than 4 thousand. Of these, the BJP won 25 seats, while the SP recorded victories in 18. The BJP is trying to correct the equation on closely contested seats before the elections by providing increased honorarium, insurance, and cashless treatment facilities to Shiksha Mitras and instructors.

stories.title: Lucknow doctor rapes 12th class student in OT:Deputy CM gets hospital sealed, cancels license; accused arrested
stories.summary: A doctor accused of raping a 12th-class student in Lucknow has been sent to jail. According to the victim, the doctor committed the rape in the operation theatre. After the Deputy CM's intervention in the case, health department officials have sealed the private hospital. The doctor's license has also been cancelled. The incident is from Tejas Hospital located in Indorabagh, Bakshi Ka Talab. Brajesh Pathak posted about the case on X writing- The Uttar Pradesh government stands with the victim daughter and her family. I assure that the accused doctor will be given the strictest punishment. I have given instructions to the Ayurvedic department officials to immediately suspend the accused's license and confiscate the degree 2 pictures of action on the hospital The student was admitted to the hospital for 3 days According to the victim's father, his daughter used to have epileptic seizures. She was admitted to Tejas Hospital on May 19 for treatment. On May 21, around 3 PM, in the hospital, the daughter suddenly had difficulty breathing. On the pretext of administering oxygen, Dr. Vijay Giri took the daughter to the operating theatre. Her elder sister, a nurse, also went with her. But shortly after, Dr. Vijay Giri sent the nurse and elder sister outside. Father says - Raped after giving an unconsciousness injection The father told the police that Dr. Vijay Giri gave his daughter an anesthesia injection through the vigo on her wrist. After this, the daughter remained unconscious. After some time, when she regained consciousness, she came out running from the operation theater. She told us that the doctor had raped her. After this, we lodged a complaint about the incident with the police. In her statement to the police, the victim said - The doctor first touched her body with wrong intentions under the pretext of treatment. He sent out my sister, who had accompanied me to the OT. Then, after giving an anesthesia injection, he committed rape. Presented BAMS degree as MBBS, kept intermediate pass in staff The accused Dr. Vijay Kumar Giri had completed BAMS from Jhansi. He was running a hospital by claiming himself to be an MBBS doctor. In his staff, intermediate pass people were taking care of patients. The doctor is accused of having made a setting with the CMO office, due to which no action was taken against him. Doctor Vijay Giri holds an Ayurvedic degree Police investigation has revealed that Dr. Vijay Giri opened Tejas Hospital in 2022 by taking a rented building. He has a degree in Ayurvedic medicine. He was treating patients in his hospital with allopathic medicines. Health department officials are engaged in investigating the matter. Officials took action after Deputy CM took cognizance Even after the victim's family complained, the CMO office officials did not take any action against the doctor. The doctor's degree and staff were not even investigated. When the ACP demanded documents related to the hospital from the CMO office, even then, the officials remained silent. When the Deputy CM himself took cognizance of the rape incident with the student, only then did the officials arrive to take action.

stories.title: UP Congress President Ajay Rai uses abusive language against Modi:Meets rape victim in Mahoba; Yogi says, 'Don’t even deserve an apology'
stories.summary: A video of Uttar Pradesh Congress President Ajay Rai has surfaced in which he is allegedly heard using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Rai had reached Mahoba on Friday to meet a NEET student who was allegedly gangraped and kidnapped, reportedly bypassing the police. After the meeting, while leaving in his car, Rai allegedly used offensive remarks against PM Modi and Mahoba SP Shashank Singh during a conversation with a party worker. The exchange was captured on camera. The video triggered sharp reactions from BJP leaders. Referring to PM Modi’s May 1 post on X, wishing Ajay Rai a speedy recovery during his illness, BJP leaders said Congress had responded to courtesy with indecency. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath also criticised Rai, saying that before him, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi had similarly displayed poor conduct. He alleged that Congress was facing frustration, despair and political bankruptcy, and was no longer in a position to apologise to the public. Gave police the slip, met victim at relative's house Ajay Rai had planned to meet the victim student on Friday. To stop him, the police had set up barricades at several places from the Bundelkhand Expressway to Mahoba. To mislead the administration, Ajay Rai's protocol for going to Sijhari village was also issued. However, giving the police the slip, he directly reached the house of a relative of the victim in the Samadnagar locality of Mahoba headquarters. Here he met the victim and her family. Ajay Rai said they had to change routes to reach the victim, alleging that otherwise they might not have been allowed to meet her. He said the girl’s suffering was immense and could not be expressed in words. He accused the police of supporting and protecting the accused. Referring to the Centre’s “Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao” slogan, Rai said it was painful that a girl aspiring to become a doctor had faced such an incident. He alleged that the BJP government had failed to ensure the safety of women and claimed that the state had turned into a “rape state.” Ajay Rai's claim- The student was held hostage for 16 days Ajay Rai said that only false promises are being made in the Yogi government. He claimed that the student was held captive for 16 days, given injections, tortured, and forcibly married, but the police remained inactive and continued to protect the criminals. The victim student's dream was to become an MBBS doctor, and she had an exam on May 3, which was disrupted due to this incident. He made 3 demands from CM Yogi. 'Will not spare oppressive officials' Ajay Rai said, 'Police are threatening our workers and office bearers. But Rahul Gandhi's soldiers are not the ones to be scared. As soon as the Congress government comes in 2027, oppressive officials will be identified, and strict action will be taken against them'. He made it clear that every single Congress worker will stand till their last breath to get justice for this Dalit daughter. BJP leader said - PM had inquired about health during illness, Ajay responded rudely Congress spokesperson said that it is not appropriate to comment without seeing the statement Dainik Bhaskar called Ajay Rai to know his side, but the mobile number was found switched off. In this matter, Dainik Bhaskar spoke with Congress spokesperson Manish Hindvi. He said that he has not yet seen Ajay Rai's statement. It would not be appropriate to make any kind of comment without seeing the statement.

stories.title: Yogi says, 'new UP known for safety and growth':Claims Ayodhya, infrastructure projects, and strict action against criminals have changed state’s national image
stories.summary: CM Yogi Adityanath launched a sharp attack on the Samajwadi Party during a rally in Deoria on Friday. He said the previous government had obstructed development, exploited the public and distributed the benefits of schemes selectively. He alleged that corruption and loot were rampant under their rule, while only their own families benefited. Highlighting the current government’s actions, Yogi said mafias and criminals have been dealt with strictly, and those who tried to terrorise the public have either fled or faced severe consequences. He said- Before 2017, daughters had to hide inside homes before 6 PM in the evening. Traders had to close their establishments, but today no one can say that daughters should cower inside homes before 6 PM and traders should close their establishments. Daughters and sisters work in industries in night shifts. They are coming home whenever they wish. If any goon dares to harass, then at the next intersection Yamraj sits ready to issue his ticket. CM Yogi inaugurated and laid the foundation stone of 19 projects worth ₹655.45 crore. Along with this, he also distributed certificates to beneficiaries of various schemes. CM Yogi's 6 major points- 1- 'Before 2017, there was one mafia in every district' Before 2017, there was one mafia in every district. There used to be riots before festivals. Poor people's lands were encroached upon. No poor person received the benefits of government schemes. Schemes were distributed based on favouritism. The youth did not get jobs. The farmer, our food provider, did not receive the benefits of government schemes. Neither the daughters were safe, nor the traders were safe. 2- 'Today no one can breach the security of daughters' Today it's not 'One District, One Mafia', but rather 'One District, One Medical College'. This is the identity of the new UP. Today, no one can breach the security of daughters. No one can forcibly collect extortion money from traders. Now, our food provider, the farmer, is not migrating. Sugarcane farmers are being paid ₹400 per quintal of sugarcane. They are getting the full price for their produce. Today, every poor person is receiving the benefits of government schemes. Instructors and Shiksha Mitras are being provided with cashless health facilities. During the SP's time, a very small amount was given as token money for the construction of Mohan Singh Setu. For a bridge whose construction was to cost more than ₹100 crores, only ₹1 lakh was given. We told the Bridge Corporation to prepare to complete the construction of the bridge on time at any cost, whatever money is required, the current government will provide it. 3- 'SP-Congress had aversion to the name of Ram itself...' We believe that currently there is a crisis in West Asia. Due to the war between America and Iran, there has been a disruption in the supply of oil and gas. Remember, residents of Deoria, when during SP's time, the Durga Puja procession in Lar was obstructed by a lathi-charge. I had to come here to protest at that time. Lathis were charged at Ram devotees during the Ram Janmabhoomi movement. That means SP-Congress had an aversion to even the name of Ram. But now see the power of the double-engine government in Ayodhya, the world's largest temple of Lord Ram has been built. This is the power of your vote. A good government comes and does good work. This becomes the cause of salvation for ancestors. Their souls must be getting true peace, and you must also be receiving blessings that your vote accomplished what has not happened anywhere else in the world. Today, Ayodhya, Kashi and Mathura-Vrindavan are visible. 4- 'Today our identity is formed through Ram, Krishna and Baba Vishwanath' Today, our identity has been formed through Ram, Krishna and Baba Vishwanath. We are receiving the blessings of all these gods and goddesses. Every resident of Uttar Pradesh has a new identity. What was this identity during SP's time? It was in the form of goons and mafia. As soon as you crossed the UP border and said you were from UP, the person in front would step back 10 paces from you. Today, wherever you go in the country, if you say that you are from UP, the face of the person in front will immediately light up, and it will seem as if they want to embrace you. This is the new identity. Those people created an identity crisis. These people were those who divided in the name of caste, broke society, and played with the interests of the country. 5- 'Will connect Deoria-Kasia four-lane with Varanasi-Lucknow' I was an MP from Gorakhpur, and back then, I used to get the opportunity to come to Deoria almost every month, because I had to come here to protest against the oppression of the then government. At that time, I used to see that the road from Gorakhpur to Deoria was barely two lanes. Even in that, at many places, it was just a single lane. One had to get stuck in traffic jams at Chauri-Chaura, because there was a railway crossing there. Today, I am pleased to inform you that the distance from Gorakhpur to Deoria has now been reduced further due to the four-lane road. Development is not going to stop now. When I came last time, the MLAs here had said that the roads should be four-lane or two-lane. We know that without good infrastructure, development is not possible. The four-lane from Deoria to Kasia is not just connectivity up to Kasia. It is part of our North-South connectivity. North-South connectivity means that Padrauna to Kasia, Kasia to Deoria and Deoria to Mau. It will be connected to the Purvanchal Expressway. It is also being connected to Varanasi and Lucknow. Good roads increase our speed, and this speed becomes the foundation of progress. 9 years ago from today, no one could even think that a medical college would be built in Deoria. 6- 'We don't give problems, we give solutions' Today, a medical college has been constructed in the name of Maharshi Devraha Baba. We have also given instructions for the construction of a new district hospital. We have been asked to identify the land as soon as possible. Any problem related to the public should not remain a problem; it should have a solution. We don't give problems. We provide solutions, and the public elects this government to provide solutions. An ITI is being built here. The ITI will be a centre for skill development. Youth will be taught skills. When we have well-trained manpower, there will be no shortage of work. This will also help boost our economy.

stories.title: FIR against 150 people for protesting power cuts in Lucknow:Power outage for more than 9 hrs; chaos throughout the night on third day
stories.summary: Amidst severe heat, power cuts are occurring for hours in Lucknow. Troubled people gheraoed several power houses on Thursday night as well. Protests took place at various locations. There were sharp exchanges with officers and employees of the electricity department. Angry people raised slogans loudly. Police somehow pacified the people. A protest lasted for more than 3 hours at night at the power house located in Gomti Nagar Sector 5. At midnight, the Janakipuram power house was gheraoed, and slogans were raised. Police that arrived at the spot pacified the people after explaining for a long time. People who reached the Bani power house late at night also created a ruckus. There was also a ruckus for several hours at night at Faizullganj and Indira Nagar Sector 25 power houses. On Thursday during the day, a case was registered at the PGI police station against 150 people who blocked Raebareli Road near the Utretia underpass. Here, people troubled by power cuts had blocked the road by placing police barricades. 3 pictures of the ruckus that took place on Thursday night Power outage for 9 hours in Chinhat area Amidst severe heat, power went out in Ashraf Vihar in Chinhat area on Thursday evening, around 5:30 pm. At around 10:30 pm at night, electricity came for 15 minutes. After that, the supply stopped again. After this, electricity came around 2:30 am at night. Even after this, power kept coming and going several times. Due to no electricity for about 9 hours, people's inverters also shut down. This caused a lot of trouble for people. People were seen spending the night walking on rooftops, balconies, streets, and parks. Elderly people, small children, and patients faced the most difficulty. Wire caught fire fiercely in Chowk A massive fire suddenly broke out in an electric wire near Irfaniya Madrasa in the Chowk area on Thursday night. Within moments, the wire started burning fiercely, and after some time, it broke and fell on the road. During the incident, a situation of panic prevailed in the area. A major accident could have occurred as the wire fell on a very busy road like Akbari Gate. It was fortunate that no one came under its grip at that time. Local people allege that the electricity system in the area has been in a dilapidated condition for a long time, but the responsible department is not paying attention to this. Employee repairing transformer gets electrocuted An electricity worker working on a transformer installed outside the second gate of Husainabad Unity College received a severe electric shock. The condition of the electricity worker became critical in the accident. It is being reported that work was going on to restore the electricity supply in the area since around 2 am on Thursday night. According to local people, no responsible officer was present at the spot. After the accident, there was chaos in the area. Local people sent the injured worker to the hospital for treatment. Road jam protest was held on Thursday during the day A protest was held for about 2 hours on Thursday morning near Buddheshwar Chowk on Mohan Road. Vehicles going to the Agra Expressway were diverted from Tikuniya Road. A protest was held for about 1 hour on Raebareli Road near Utarethiya Underpass. The protesters jammed the road using police barricades. During this, they had a sharp altercation with the police. Before this, on Wednesday and Tuesday night, there was chaos at different power houses. Angry people surrounded the power houses and raised slogans loudly. Seeing the anger of the people, officers and employees of the electricity department fled from several power houses. It is alleged that at Faizullahganj Power House, the police lathi-charged and chased away the people. At Faizullahganj sub-center, Uday Raj, a lineman working on contract, died due to electrocution while working on an 11,000-volt line. Uproar for 3 days, power house siege, and road jam Earlier on Thursday, during the day, people had protested by blocking Raebareli Road and Mohan Road. On Wednesday night, they had laid siege to Utaraithiya New and Old Power House, BBAU Power House, and Faizullahganj Power House. On Monday night, too, several powerhouses were besieged. People say that due to the negligence of the electricity department, power remains out for hours. This daily routine has been completely disrupted. 3 pictures of protests on Mohan Road and Raebareli Road... 3 pictures of the commotion that took place on Wednesday midnight MLA sat on dharna during the day on Wednesday On Tuesday night, there was also commotion at several power houses. On Wednesday, Lucknow West Assembly MLA Arman Khan sat on a dharna at Talkatora Power House. 3 pictures of the commotion that happened on Tuesday night MLA Rajeshwar Singh wrote a letter to the Energy Minister Regarding the continuously deteriorating electricity system in Sarojininagar Assembly constituency, Sarojininagar MLA Dr. Rajeshwar Singh sent a complaint letter to the Energy Minister of Uttar Pradesh. In the letter, he has demanded a comprehensive review of the power supply system and the creation of a permanent action plan. In the letter, the MLA wrote that at present, electricity supply in many areas, including Lucknow, has become a matter of serious concern. Due to frequent power disruptions, discontent among the general public is continuously increasing. This problem is not limited to just the current season, but similar situations have been arising during summers in previous years as well. Named each and every colony Dr. Rajeshwar Singh has specifically mentioned several powerhouses in the Sarojininagar area and the neighborhoods connected to them in his letter, where there is a continuous electricity crisis. He mentioned the continuous problems of low voltage and tripping in areas like Devi Kheda, Pavanpuri, Ambedkar Puram, Sarpatganj, Kuber Bagiya, Gandhi Nagar, Ratandinagar, Baldev Vihar, Shubhani Kheda, Brahmin Tola, Rajiv Nagar, Natakkheda, Sainik Nagar, Bangali Tola, Neelmatha, Nai Basti Bazaar, Kateri Bagh, Vijay Nagar, Rewatapur, Bhagwantnagar, and Durgapuri in the Uttarethiya Powerhouse area. Additionally, problems of Bijnor, Royal City, Himalayan Colony, and Natkuda in the BBAU Powerhouse area, Shantinagar, Pandit Kheda, Amausi, Gauri, and Santkabir Nagar in the Nadarganj Powerhouse area, as well as several villages and colonies in Gehru and Bani Powerhouse areas, have also been presented before the Energy Minister. At the same time, a demand for the resolution of the problem has been made.

stories.title: Car falls into gorge in Nainital, 5 dead:Victims include husband-wife and 2 children; family had come from Lucknow
stories.summary: Five people were killed after a car plunged nearly 100 metres into a deep gorge in Uttarakhand’s Nainital on Thursday. According to eyewitnesses, the car got stuck after hitting a tree while falling down the gorge. Due to the depth of the gorge, the rescue team had to descend using ropes. After a strenuous operation, the bodies were recovered and sent to Bhawali Primary Hospital for postmortem. The deceased included members of the same family: Bhupendra Singh Chufal (48), his wife Seema Kaida Chufal (45), son Vasu Chufal (19), and daughter Ravi Chufal (12). The family originally belonged to Khatima in Udham Singh Nagar and had been living in Lucknow for a long time. Car driver Anuj Kumar Mishra (34) also died in the accident. CM Dhami expresses grief over the incident Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, in a post on social media platform X, said that the news of the accident in Nainital district was extremely tragic. He prayed for peace to the souls of those who lost their lives in the accident and wished strength to the bereaved families to bear the loss. Dhami said that relief and rescue operations were being carried out by the local administration and SDRF. He also prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured.

stories.title: Allahabad HC seeks crime records of 50 strongmen:Raja Bhaiya and Dhananjay Singh also included; orders probe into gun licences and security cover
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court has sought the criminal records of more than 50 strongmen, including Raghuraj Pratap Singh, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh and Dhananjay Singh, from the Uttar Pradesh government. The court has also ordered an inquiry into the gun licences and security cover provided to these individuals. While hearing the matter, the court reprimanded Home Department officials and directed them to submit an investigation report by May 26. Petition alleged irregularities in arms licence process The matter came before the court after a petition was filed by Jaishankar alias Barrister, a resident of Sant Kabir Nagar. The petitioner alleged that rules were being ignored while issuing arms licences in the state. During the hearing on May 18, Justice Vinod Diwakar passed the order. The directive was later uploaded on the High Court website on May 20. Court surprised by figures presented in govt affidavit The High Court expressed surprise after examining the affidavit submitted by the state government. According to the Home Department’s affidavit, more than 10 lakh arms licences have currently been issued across Uttar Pradesh, while over 23,000 applications are still pending. The affidavit further stated that more than 6,000 people facing two or more criminal cases have also been granted arms licences. Additionally, nearly 21,000 families in the state possess more than one arms licence. The government also informed the court that 1,738 appeals against decisions taken by police authorities and district magistrates are currently pending before commissioners.

stories.title: UP officials barred from foreign travel for 7 months:Cycling tracks planned, AC use to be restricted as Yogi govt tightens energy-saving measures
stories.summary: Amid concerns over a deepening energy crisis, the Uttar Pradesh government has imposed a seven-month ban on non-essential foreign travel by government officials. The government has also directed departments to create dedicated cycling tracks within a radius of 5 to 10 kilometres in cities. Additionally, the electricity consumption of government vehicles, generators and office buildings older than 10 years will be investigated. The instructions were issued by Praveen Kumar, Special Secretary to the UP government. Urban Development Department issues detailed energy-saving guidelines Praveen Kumar instructed officials that all meetings of the Urban Development Department must now be conducted online. Inter-district meetings, training sessions and seminars will only be held through video conferencing. Officials have also been directed to minimise the use of air conditioners, lights and lifts in offices. The order states that AC temperatures must be maintained between 24°C and 26°C. The directive was issued on May 21 in response to the energy crisis linked to the ongoing Iran-US and Israel conflict in the Middle East. According to the order, the conflict has disrupted crude oil and gas supplies through the Strait of Hormuz, directly impacting India’s energy situation. PM Modi urged people to cut fuel use and foreign travel Prime Minister Narendra Modi, during public addresses on May 10 and 11, appealed to citizens to reduce the use of petrol, diesel and cooking gas. He also urged people to avoid unnecessary foreign travel, reduce gold purchases and promote work-from-home practices. Key instructions issued by the government Earlier, Yogi govt reduced convoys and pushed virtual meetings Earlier last Tuesday, the government had announced seven major measures to reduce fuel and energy consumption. The convoy size of the Chief Minister, ministers, MLAs and officials was ordered to be reduced by up to 50%. Officials and public representatives were also asked to use public transport, buses or metro services at least one day a week. The government decided that all official meetings, seminars, conferences and workshops would be held virtually. Around 50% of state secretariat meetings will also be conducted online. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had additionally suggested issuing an advisory encouraging companies with large workforces to adopt work-from-home practices two days a week. PM Modi: India must reduce dependence on fuel Prime Minister Modi had said during his speeches on May 10 and 11 that the country must reduce dependence on petrol, diesel and gas. He noted that fuel prices had risen globally because of the ongoing conflict in the region and said India was more vulnerable because it does not possess large oil reserves. The Prime Minister also promoted work-from-home arrangements and encouraged residents of metro cities to use public transport systems. Referring to gold purchases, he said that while people once donated gold during wartime, citizens should now pledge not to buy gold for the next year in order to help conserve foreign exchange reserves.

stories.title: AC bus catches fire on Agra–Lucknow Expressway:Collides with dumper in Firozabad; driver burnt alive, dozens injured
stories.summary: A dumper truck and an AC bus collided late on Thursday night at 2 am on the Agra–Lucknow Expressway in Firozabad. Following the crash, the bus caught fire, reportedly due to a short circuit, and flames quickly engulfed the entire vehicle. The bus driver and conducter died in the incident, while around two dozen passengers are reported to have been injured. The AC bus, carrying 28 passengers, was travelling from Kanpur to Gurugram. The accident took place in the Matsena police station area. Bus crashes into dumper after it hits divider According to eyewitnesses, the dumper truck, loaded with sand, first rammed into the divider on the expressway. Moments later, the bus coming from behind crashed into the dumper. Soon after the collision, the bus caught fire, triggering panic among passengers. In an attempt to save themselves, several passengers broke the bus windows and jumped out. Passengers injured while escaping flames Many passengers suffered serious injuries while jumping onto the road. Some sustained fractured arms and legs, while several others suffered severe head injuries. Passersby alerted emergency services, following which four to five fire brigade vehicles reached the spot within 10 minutes. Firefighters rescued three passengers trapped inside the burning bus and managed to bring the blaze under control after nearly three hours. Driver’s body found stuck in steering wheel After the fire was extinguished, officials inspected the bus and found the body of the driver, identified as Shambhu, trapped in the steering wheel. Police said the body was so badly burnt that only skeletal remains were recovered. All injured passengers have been admitted to the Medical College and Shikohabad hospital for treatment. See pictures of the accident- Injured passenger says people were screaming after crash Mukesh, an injured passenger from Kanpur, said he was travelling to Vrindavan with his sister when the accident occurred. “We were asleep at the time of the crash. When I woke up, I saw blood coming from my leg. People were screaming and crying for help. I jumped out of the bus to save my life,” he said.

stories.title: Banda remains hottest for 5th straight day:Cold rooms set up in hospitals; heatwave alert in 50 districts, nights to remain warm
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh continues to reel under intense heatwave conditions, with Banda remaining the hottest city in the country for the fifth consecutive day. The daytime temperature there was recorded at 47.6°C. Just two days earlier, the mercury had touched 48.2°C. On Thursday, temperatures crossed 45°C in seven cities across the state. Prayagraj recorded 46.6°C, Varanasi 45.6°C, Hamirpur and Sultanpur 45.2°C each, while Amethi registered 45.1°C. In Lucknow, the temperature reached 43.6°C, the highest recorded in the city this season. Heatwave alert issued for 50 districts A heatwave and extreme heat alert has been issued for 50 districts in the state on Friday. Out of these, 11 districts are under a red alert, indicating severe heatwave conditions and scorching hot winds. An orange alert for warm nights has also been issued for western UP, while eastern UP remains under a red alert for unusually warm nights. This means residents are unlikely to get relief even after sunset, with night temperatures expected to remain between 25°C and 30°C. Special hospital ward prepared in Lucknow In Lucknow, hospitals have begun special preparations to deal with heatstroke and heat-related illnesses. A dedicated 10-bed ward has been set up for patients suffering from heatstroke. Dr Devesh Chandra Pandey, Chief Medical Superintendent of Civil Hospital, said a special cooling zone with three air-conditioned rooms has also been prepared. The hospital has arranged ORS solutions and ice packs for emergency treatment. Shower system installed for cattle in Chitrakoot In Chitrakoot, a shower system has been installed to protect cattle from the extreme heat. Animals are being kept inside sheds between 10am and 4pm to shield them from direct sunlight and hot winds. Hot winds from Pakistan and Thar desert worsening conditions According to the Meteorological Department, dry and extremely hot winds originating from Balochistan in Pakistan and the Thar Desert are directly reaching the plains of north India. As a result, Uttar Pradesh is experiencing June-like heat conditions in May itself. Lucknow-based meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said- A trough line is passing from Manipur through northern UP. Because of this, easterly winds are blowing across several districts of the state. This has intensified the heat. Due to strong sunlight and heatwave conditions, the temperature being felt is around 2°C to 3°C higher than the actual recorded temperature. At present, there is no hope of relief for at least the next seven days. Severe heatwave conditions are likely in the state. Weather forecast for the next five days May 23- Intense sunshine is expected across Uttar Pradesh. Hot winds may blow at speeds of up to 40 kmph. Nights will remain unusually warm. May 24- Weather in western UP is expected to remain dry with strong sunshine. Heatwave conditions are likely in most cities of eastern UP. May 25- Hot winds with speeds up to 40 kmph are expected in western UP, while eastern UP will continue to witness intense sunshine. May 26- Strong sunshine and heatwave conditions are likely across the state. Dust storms may occur in eastern UP. May 27- An orange alert for severe heat has been issued across Uttar Pradesh. Dust-laden winds with speeds up to 40 kmph are likely in eastern UP.
